zh.title: QR Code 瓶蓋互動展示系統
zh.summary: 建立一套可實際展示「一瓶一碼」功能的 QR Code 測試系統，讓業務人員在向客戶推廣 QR Code 瓶蓋時，不再只依賴簡報或口頭說明，而是可以直接使用實體樣品進行掃碼展示。
zh.author: 徐馬克
zh.region: 台灣、海外市場

tools.name: Claude
tools.desc: 用於需求整理、網頁程式碼產生、功能修改與除錯。

tools.name: GitHub
tools.desc: 用於儲存與管理網站程式碼。

tools.name: GitHub Pages
tools.desc: 用於部署測試網站，讓業務人員可直接透過網址進行展示。

zh.problem_background: 公司在推廣 QR Code 瓶蓋時，業務人員通常只能透過簡報、圖片或口頭方式向客戶說明產品功能。由於客戶無法在現場實際掃描 QR Code 並體驗操作流程，因此較難直觀理解「一瓶一碼」、「防止重複兌換」及「多語言互動」等功能，影響產品展示效果與業務溝通效率。
zh.core_problem: 業務人員缺少一套可以搭配實體瓶蓋使用的展示環境，無法在拜訪客戶、參加展覽或進行產品提案時，實際呈現 QR Code 瓶蓋的應用方式。
zh.solution: 建立一個 QR Code 瓶蓋測試網站，並為每一組展示用 QR Code 設定不同的識別碼。由塑蓋廠協助製作帶有 QR Code 的瓶蓋樣品，業務人員可在客戶現場直接使用手機掃描瓶蓋上的 QR Code，展示完整的使用流程。掃描後，系統會依照 QR Code 的專屬代碼顯示對應頁面，並記錄該代碼是否已經被掃描或使用。
process: 請塑蓋廠將 QR Code 製作於瓶蓋樣品上。
業務人員攜帶實體樣品拜訪客戶。
客戶使用手機掃描瓶蓋上的 QR Code。
系統呈現首次掃描或重複掃描的不同結果。
依客戶需求切換中文、英文或泰文介面。

features.name: 一瓶一碼
features.desc: 每一個瓶蓋都具有獨立的 QR Code 識別碼，可模擬一個產品對應一組專屬代碼的應用情境。

features.name: 重複掃碼提示
features.desc: 當同一組 QR Code 被再次掃描時，系統會顯示已掃描或已使用提示，讓客戶理解此功能可應用於：防偽驗證、抽獎活動、點數兌換、優惠券領取、一次性活動資格、商品追蹤。

features.name: 多國語言支援
features.desc: 目前支援繁體中文、英文、泰文，可依照業務推廣地區與客戶語言需求，持續增加其他語言版本。

features.name: 行動裝置支援
features.desc: 網站可透過手機瀏覽器直接開啟，不需另外安裝 App，適合業務拜訪、展覽及客戶提案使用。

ai_usage: 釐清網站功能需求
規劃使用者操作流程
產生網頁程式碼
設計多語言內容
協助程式除錯
優化手機版頁面
建立 GitHub Pages 部署流程
results: 建立可實際操作的 QR Code 瓶蓋展示網站。
將原本只能透過口頭說明的功能，轉換為可掃描、可操作的實體展示。
業務人員不需要具備程式開發能力，即可直接使用。
可搭配瓶蓋樣品、產品提案及展覽活動使用。
提升客戶對 QR Code 瓶蓋應用方式的理解。
降低業務與客戶之間的溝通成本。
建立後續客製化專案的初步驗證環境。

value.name: 對業務單位
value.desc: 讓業務人員從「說明功能」轉變為「直接展示功能」，提高產品提案的具體性與說服力。

value.name: 對客戶
value.desc: 客戶可以親自操作並理解 QR Code 瓶蓋的使用情境，更容易提出進一步需求。

value.name: 對公司
value.desc: 在正式投入大型系統開發前，先透過低成本原型驗證市場需求，降低開發錯誤與投資風險。

extensions: 瓶蓋防偽驗證
商品真偽查詢
消費者抽獎活動
點數累積與兌換
優惠券領取
產品履歷查詢
生產批號追蹤
客戶問卷調查
行銷活動導流
經銷商或通路管理
售後服務登錄
多國市場產品展示
limitations: 使用者資料與個資保護
QR Code 防複製機制
資料庫與掃碼紀錄保存
系統流量與穩定性
活動規則與兌換邏輯
後台管理功能
網路安全
正式網域與主機部署
客戶資料權限管理
系統維護責任
zh.success_key: 本案例的重點並不是建立一個完整的大型系統，而是先利用 AI 快速製作可操作的原型，讓需求單位能夠實際使用、測試與收集回饋。透過小規模驗證，可以先確認客戶是否理解、業務是否方便使用，以及哪些功能真正具有價值，再決定是否進一步投入正式開發。

en.title: QR Code Bottle Cap Interactive Demo System
en.summary: Built a QR code bottle cap demo system that lets sales staff show the real "one bottle, one code" experience to customers in person, using an actual sample cap instead of relying only on slides or verbal explanation.
en.author: Mark Hsu

tools.name: Claude
tools.desc: Used for requirements clarification, generating web code, making changes, and debugging.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.desc: Used to store and manage the website's source code.

tools.name: GitHub Pages
tools.desc: Used to deploy the demo site so sales staff can showcase it directly via a URL.

en.problem_background: When promoting QR code bottle caps, sales staff could usually only explain the feature through slides, photos, or verbal description. Since customers couldn't actually scan a QR code and try the flow on the spot, it was hard for them to intuitively grasp concepts like "one bottle, one code", "preventing duplicate redemption", and "multi-language interaction" — which limited the demo's impact and slowed down sales communication.
en.core_problem: Sales staff lacked a demo environment that could be paired with a physical bottle cap, so they had no way to actually show how QR code bottle caps work during customer visits, trade shows, or proposals.
en.solution: Built a QR code bottle cap demo website and assigned a unique code to each demo QR code. The cap manufacturer produced sample caps with QR codes printed on them, so sales staff could scan the cap's QR code directly with a phone in front of the customer and walk through the full flow. After scanning, the system shows a page based on the code's unique ID and records whether that code has already been scanned or used.
process: Ask the cap manufacturer to print QR codes on sample bottle caps.
Sales staff bring the physical samples to customer visits.
Customers scan the QR code on the cap with their phone.
The system shows a different result for a first scan versus a repeat scan.
Switch between Chinese, English, or Thai based on the customer's needs.

features.name: One Bottle, One Code
features.desc: Every bottle cap has its own unique QR code, simulating a scenario where each product maps to one dedicated code.

features.name: Duplicate Scan Notice
features.desc: When the same QR code is scanned again, the system shows an "already scanned/used" notice, helping customers understand how this can be applied to anti-counterfeiting, lucky draws, point redemption, coupon claims, one-time event eligibility, and product tracking.

features.name: Multi-language Support
features.desc: Currently supports Traditional Chinese, English, and Thai, with more languages to be added as sales expand into new regions.

features.name: Mobile-friendly
features.desc: The site opens directly in a phone browser with no app install required, making it ideal for customer visits, trade shows, and proposals.

ai_usage: Clarifying the website's functional requirements
Planning the user flow
Generating the web code
Designing multi-language content
Helping debug the code
Optimizing the mobile layout
Setting up the GitHub Pages deployment
results: Built a working QR code bottle cap demo website.
Turned a feature that could only be explained verbally into something customers can scan and try themselves.
Sales staff can use it directly with no coding skills required.
Can be paired with sample caps, product proposals, and trade show events.
Improved customer understanding of how QR code bottle caps can be used.
Lowered the communication cost between sales and customers.
Created an early-stage validation environment for future custom projects.

value.name: For the Sales Team
value.desc: Shifts sales staff from "explaining the feature" to "demonstrating the feature", making product pitches more concrete and persuasive.

value.name: For Customers
value.desc: Customers can try it themselves and understand how QR code bottle caps work in practice, making it easier for them to raise further requirements.

value.name: For the Company
value.desc: Validates market demand through a low-cost prototype before committing to full-scale development, reducing development risk and wasted investment.

extensions: Bottle cap anti-counterfeiting verification
Product authenticity lookup
Consumer lucky draws
Points accumulation and redemption
Coupon claims
Product traceability lookup
Production batch tracking
Customer surveys
Marketing campaign traffic
Distributor/channel management
After-sales service registration
Multi-market product demos
limitations: User data and privacy protection
QR code anti-copy mechanism
Database and scan-record storage
System traffic and stability
Event rules and redemption logic
Admin/back-office features
Network security
Production domain and hosting setup
Customer data access control
System maintenance ownership
en.success_key: The point of this case isn't to build a full-scale system — it's to use AI to quickly build a working prototype so the requesting team can actually use it, test it, and gather feedback. Small-scale validation lets us confirm whether customers understand it, whether sales staff find it easy to use, and which features are genuinely valuable, before deciding whether to invest further in full development.

zh.title: 飲料代工產線智慧查詢網站
zh.summary: 利用 AI 協助整理集團現有的飲料代工產線資料，並製作成互動式查詢網站。業務人員或客戶可以根據飲料類型、產品規格、設備及認證需求，快速查詢較合適的生產線，作為後續業務洽談與產線評估的參考。
zh.author: 徐馬克
zh.problem_background: 集團在不同地區擁有多條飲料代工產線，各產線支援的飲料類型、設備條件、包裝規格及認證有所不同。當業務人員收到客戶需求時，通常需要查詢不同資料，或詢問熟悉各工廠產線的人員，才能初步判斷適合的生產地點與產線。由於資料較為分散，也不容易讓客戶快速了解集團的整體代工能力。
zh.core_problem: 如何將集團現有的產線資料整合成簡單、容易查詢的工具，讓業務人員及客戶可以根據產品需求，快速找到較合適的產線。
zh.solution: 整理集團現有的飲料代工產線、設備、規格及認證資料，並利用 AI 協助進行資料分類、網站流程規劃與程式開發。使用者只要依照產品需求選擇相關條件，網站即可協助篩選較符合需求的產線，作為後續評估與洽談的參考。
features: 方便業務人員或客戶根據飲料類型、產品規格、設備及認證需求，查詢較合適的飲料代工產線。
網站同時提供中文、英文及日文介面，方便不同地區的使用者查詢。
ai_usage: 整理及分類集團產線資料
將複雜的產線條件轉換成查詢選項
規劃網站操作流程
建立產線篩選邏輯
產生及修改網站程式碼
建立多國語言內容
協助測試與程式除錯
results: 將分散的產線資訊整理成可查詢的結構化資料。
建立可供業務及客戶自行操作的產線查詢網站。
縮短業務查找產線資料及跨單位確認的時間。
降低產線資訊對特定人員經驗的依賴。
讓客戶更容易了解集團的飲料代工能力。
將原本靜態的資料轉換成互動式查詢工具。

value.name: 對業務人員
value.desc: 收到客戶需求後，可以先透過網站進行初步查詢，更快速地判斷可能合適的產線。

value.name: 對客戶
value.desc: 可以依照自己的產品需求進行查詢，更容易了解集團可提供的飲料代工服務。

extensions: 塑膠瓶蓋規格查詢
瓶胚與瓶型查詢
爪蓋規格查詢
標籤材料與印刷方式查詢
集團設備與生產能力查詢
其他產品選型與業務支援工具
limitations: 網站提供的結果主要用於初步查詢及需求溝通，不代表正式的生產承諾。
實際能否生產，仍需由相關單位進一步確認產品配方、包裝規格、生產數量、工廠產能、認證、排程及其他生產條件。
產線資料也需要定期更新，以確保網站資訊與實際生產狀況一致。

en.title: Beverage Contract Manufacturing Line Finder
en.summary: Used AI to help organize the group's existing beverage contract manufacturing line data into an interactive lookup website. Sales staff and customers can search by beverage type, product spec, equipment, and certification needs to quickly find a suitable production line for follow-up business discussions and line evaluation.
en.author: Mark Hsu
en.problem_background: The group operates multiple beverage contract manufacturing lines across different regions, each supporting different beverage types, equipment conditions, packaging specs, and certifications. When sales staff receive a customer request, they usually need to search through different sources or ask people familiar with each plant's lines just to get a rough sense of a suitable production location. Because the data is scattered, it's also hard for customers to quickly grasp the group's overall contract manufacturing capabilities.
en.core_problem: How to consolidate the group's existing production line data into a simple, searchable tool so sales staff and customers can quickly find a suitable line based on product requirements.
en.solution: Organized the group's existing beverage contract manufacturing lines, equipment, specs, and certification data, and used AI to help with data classification, site planning, and development. Users simply select the relevant conditions based on their product needs, and the site helps filter production lines that best match the requirements as a reference for further evaluation and discussion.
features: Lets sales staff or customers search for a suitable beverage contract manufacturing line based on beverage type, product spec, equipment, and certification needs.
The site is available in Chinese, English, and Japanese to serve users from different regions.
ai_usage: Organizing and classifying the group's production line data
Turning complex line conditions into searchable filter options
Planning the site's user flow
Building the line-filtering logic
Generating and editing the website code
Creating multi-language content
Helping with testing and debugging
results: Turned scattered production line information into structured, searchable data.
Built a production line lookup site that sales and customers can use themselves.
Reduced the time sales staff spend finding line data and cross-checking with other teams.
Reduced reliance on any one person's knowledge of the production lines.
Made it easier for customers to understand the group's beverage contract manufacturing capabilities.
Turned static reference data into an interactive lookup tool.

value.name: For Sales Staff
value.desc: After receiving a customer request, they can run a quick initial search on the site to judge which line might be suitable, much faster than before.

value.name: For Customers
value.desc: Customers can search based on their own product needs, making it easier to understand the contract manufacturing services the group can offer.

extensions: Plastic bottle cap spec lookup
Preform and bottle shape lookup
Tamper-evident cap spec lookup
Label material and printing method lookup
Group equipment and production capacity lookup
Other product selection and sales support tools
limitations: The results are mainly for early-stage lookup and requirement discussion, and do not represent a formal production commitment.

Whether production is actually feasible still needs to be confirmed by the relevant teams — covering product formula, packaging spec, order quantity, plant capacity, certification, scheduling, and other production conditions.
The production line data also needs to be updated regularly to keep the site's information consistent with actual production status.

zh.title: 調撥單辨識與 Excel 自動產生系統
zh.summary: 利用 Claude OCR 辨識調撥單中的文字與欄位資料，並自動整理及產生 Excel 檔案。現場人員只需要上傳調撥單的圖片或 PDF，系統即可協助完成資料辨識、批次彙整及 Excel 匯出，減少人工輸入與整理時間。
zh.author: 徐馬克

tools.name: Claude OCR
tools.desc: 辨識調撥單文字與欄位資料。屬於付費服務，目前實際使用費用約為每月 1 美元，費用會依上傳的單據數量、頁數及辨識使用量而有所變動。

zh.problem_background: 現場人員收到調撥單後，需要人工查看單據內容，再將日期、品號、數量、棧板數及其他資料輸入 Excel。當調撥單數量較多時，人工輸入及整理需要花費較多時間，也可能發生資料輸入錯誤或遺漏。
zh.core_problem: 如何減少現場人員人工查看及輸入調撥單資料的時間，並將多張單據快速整理成統一的 Excel 檔案。
zh.solution: 建立調撥單辨識系統，讓現場人員上傳調撥單的圖片或 PDF。系統利用 Claude OCR 辨識單據內容，解析日期、所別、裝運單號、品號、數量及棧板數等資料，經人員確認後，可將多張調撥單彙整並匯出成 Excel 檔案。
features: 支援上傳調撥單圖片及 PDF，系統可自動辨識單據內容、彙整多張調撥單，並產生 Excel 檔案。
PDF 可進行多頁批次辨識，使用者也能在匯出前確認辨識結果，降低資料錯誤的風險。
ai_usage: 辨識調撥單文字
解析單據欄位
擷取品號與數量
處理不同格式的調撥單
將辨識結果轉換為結構化資料
辨識完成後仍保留人工確認步驟，避免因圖片品質、手寫內容或單據格式差異造成錯誤。
results: 將調撥單內容自動轉換為結構化資料。
支援 JPG、PNG、BMP 圖片及多頁 PDF 上傳。
可一次處理多張或多頁調撥單。
自動彙整品號、數量與相關資料。
可將整理結果匯出為 Excel 檔案。
減少現場人員人工輸入及整理資料的時間。
降低大量人工輸入可能產生的錯誤。

value.name: 對現場人員
value.desc: 不需要逐筆將調撥單內容輸入 Excel，只需上傳檔案並確認辨識結果，即可完成資料整理。

value.name: 對管理人員
value.desc: 調撥資料可以用一致的格式進行彙整，方便後續查詢、庫存管理及資料分析。

value.name: 對公司
value.desc: 以每月約 1 美元的 AI 使用成本，降低重複性人工操作時間，並驗證 AI 文件辨識在現場作業中的實際應用價值。

extensions: 訂購單辨識
出貨單辨識
送貨單辨識
庫存單據整理
生產報表輸入
品質檢查表整理
發票及費用單據辨識
其他紙本表單數位化
limitations: OCR 辨識結果會受到單據清晰度、拍攝角度、圖片解析度及文件格式影響，因此匯出 Excel 前仍需由使用者確認。
若系統辨識到不在既有清單中的品號，需由人員確認或新增，避免錯誤資料直接計入庫存表。
Claude OCR 為外部付費服務，正式使用時需留意單據內容是否包含敏感或機密資料。
需留意 API 使用權限與帳號管理。
需留意每月辨識費用及使用量。
需留意 OCR 服務中斷時的替代處理方式。

en.title: Transfer Order Recognition & Excel Auto-Generation System
en.summary: Uses Claude OCR to recognize the text and fields on transfer orders and automatically compiles them into an Excel file. Frontline staff simply upload a photo or PDF of the transfer order, and the system handles recognition, batch consolidation, and Excel export — cutting down manual data entry and organizing time.
en.author: Mark Hsu

tools.name: Claude OCR
tools.desc: Recognizes the text and field data on transfer orders. This is a paid service; actual usage currently costs about US$1 per month, varying with the number of documents, pages, and recognition volume uploaded.

en.problem_background: After receiving a transfer order, frontline staff had to manually review the document and then enter the date, item number, quantity, pallet count, and other data into Excel. When there were many transfer orders, manual entry and organizing took a lot of time and was prone to data entry errors or omissions.
en.core_problem: How to reduce the time frontline staff spend manually reviewing and entering transfer order data, and quickly consolidate multiple documents into a unified Excel file.
en.solution: Built a transfer order recognition system that lets frontline staff upload a photo or PDF of a transfer order. Claude OCR recognizes the document content and parses out the date, department, shipment number, item number, quantity, pallet count, and other data. After staff confirm the results, multiple transfer orders can be consolidated and exported to an Excel file.
features: Supports uploading transfer order images and PDFs; the system automatically recognizes the document content, consolidates multiple transfer orders, and generates an Excel file.
PDFs can be recognized in multi-page batches, and users can confirm the recognition results before exporting to reduce the risk of data errors.
ai_usage: Recognizing text on transfer orders
Parsing document fields
Extracting item numbers and quantities
Handling different transfer order formats
Converting recognition results into structured data
Keeping a manual confirmation step after recognition to avoid errors from image quality, handwriting, or format differences.
results: Automatically converts transfer order content into structured data.
Supports JPG, PNG, BMP images and multi-page PDF uploads.
Can process multiple documents or pages at once.
Automatically consolidates item numbers, quantities, and related data.
Can export the organized results as an Excel file.
Reduces the time frontline staff spend on manual data entry and organizing.
Lowers the risk of errors from large-volume manual entry.

value.name: For Frontline Staff
value.desc: No need to enter transfer order content line by line into Excel — just upload the file and confirm the recognition results to complete the data organization.

value.name: For Managers
value.desc: Transfer data can be consolidated in a consistent format, making it easier for follow-up lookup, inventory management, and data analysis.

value.name: For the Company

zh.problem_background: 職安衛人員在進行法規鑑定時，需要將政府法規網站上的條文逐條複製到 Excel，再依公司格式整理成法規鑑定登錄表。當法規條文較多時，逐條複製、整理欄位及調整格式會花費大量時間，也容易發生條文遺漏、複製錯誤或格式不一致的情況。
zh.core_problem: 如何減少職安衛人員手動複製與整理法規條文的時間，並快速轉換成公司可直接使用的法規鑑定登錄表。

en.title: Hon Chuan EHS Regulation Organizer
en.summary: Built a regulation organizer site so EHS staff only need to paste a government regulation URL to automatically convert the legal text into the company's regulation assessment register format, exportable as Excel or PDF. Users can then fill in the implementation status, compliance assessment, and related notes directly in the organized table, cutting down the time spent manually copying regulation text.
en.author: Mark Hsu
en.problem_background: When conducting regulation assessments, EHS staff had to manually copy each article of a regulation from a government website into Excel, then organize it into the company's regulation assessment register format. When there were many articles, copying, formatting, and organizing the fields took a lot of time and was prone to missed articles, copy errors, or inconsistent formatting.
en.core_problem: How to reduce the time EHS staff spend manually copying and organizing regulation text, and quickly convert it into a regulation assessment register the company can use directly.
en.solution: Built a regulation organizer site where users paste the URL of a government regulation page. The system automatically reads the regulation name, article numbers, and article text, and organizes it into the company's regulation assessment register format. Users can then fill in the implementation status, compliance assessment, and related notes, and finally export the result as Excel or PDF. Since some public CORS proxy services became paid or unreliable over time, a companion "HC Regulation" browser extension was built so the site can bypass the browser's cross-origin restrictions and read government regulation sites directly, with the public proxy services kept only as a fallback.
features: After pasting a government regulation URL, the system automatically extracts and organizes the regulation text into the company's regulation assessment register format.
The organized results can be exported as Excel or PDF for EHS staff to fill in further and keep on file.

en.title: Product Catalog App (iOS)
en.summary: Organized the group's product specifications into an iOS product catalog app, letting sales staff quickly look up bottle caps, preforms, and related product information from a phone or tablet. Users can search and filter by product criteria, cutting down the time spent digging through catalogs, spec sheets, or asking other departments — handy for customer visits and everyday product lookups.
en.author: Mark Hsu
en.problem_background: The group has a wide range of products and specs, and product data can be scattered across catalogs, spec sheets, or different files. When visiting customers or responding to product questions, sales staff had to spend time searching for the right data, and if unfamiliar with a product, might also need to ask colleagues to confirm the spec.
en.core_problem: How to consolidate the group's product data so sales staff can quickly look up product specs from their phone at any time.
en.solution: Organized the group's existing product specs into a database and developed an iOS product catalog app. Sales staff can use search and filter features to look up dimensions, weight, neck finish type, and production site for bottle caps, preforms, and other products, as a reference for customer conversations and product selection. Per the App Store listing, the app currently covers more than 200 product specs across production sites in Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia.

zh.title: COA 製作與寄送自動化流程
zh.summary: 透過 Python 與 n8n 建立 COA 自動化流程，將原本需要人工整理出貨資料、製作 COA 及逐封寄送郵件的作業，整合成標準化流程。品保人員完成出貨資料確認後，系統可自動產生 COA，並依照客戶資料夾及收件人清單，自動判斷寄送對象、加入副本收件人及寄出對應的 COA，減少重複操作時間。
zh.author: 謝欣錫
zh.problem_background: COA 製作與寄送原本包含多項人工操作。品保人員需要先到倉儲確認出貨日期及數量，再將出貨資料輸入指定檔案，製作對應的 COA。完成後，還需要依不同客戶查找收件人、確認副本對象、建立郵件並逐一寄送。當出貨批次或客戶數量增加時，這些重複作業會占用較多時間，也容易因人工輸入、檔案分類或收件人設定錯誤，造成 COA 資料或寄送內容不正確。
zh.core_problem: 如何將 COA 的資料整理、文件產生、客戶判斷及郵件寄送流程標準化，減少品保人員重複輸入與逐封寄送郵件的時間。
zh.solution:
整體流程分為兩個部分：

COA 製作自動化：品保人員確認出貨日期及數量後，透過 Python 將出貨單轉換成系統可讀取的格式，並將出貨資訊整理至指定檔案中。系統再根據整理後的出貨資料，自動產生對應的 COA，減少人工逐份製作文件的作業。

COA 寄送自動化：先建立包含客戶關鍵字、主要收件人及副本收件人的清單，並依照客戶名稱分類待寄送的 COA。品保人員只需要將 COA 放入指定位置，設定本次出貨日期及寄件人後執行 n8n 工作流。系統便會自動讀取檔案、判斷對應客戶、查找收件人清單，並將 COA 寄送給正確的客戶及相關人員。
process: 人員確認出貨日期及出貨數量。
使用 Python 轉換出貨單格式。
將出貨資訊整理至指定資料檔案。
使用 Python 自動產生 COA。
將待寄送的 COA 依客戶分類。
系統讀取客戶與收件人對照清單。
執行前設定出貨日期及寄件人。
啟動 n8n 自動化工作流。
系統判斷客戶並配對收件人。
自動附加 COA 並寄送郵件。
features: 將出貨資料自動轉換並產生 COA。
支援多個客戶與多份 COA 批次處理。
依客戶名稱自動判斷對應收件人。

自動將正確的 COA 附加至對應郵件。
透過 n8n 工作流完成批次郵件寄送。
保留出貨日期與寄件人等執行參數，方便不同批次使用。

en.title: COA Generation & Dispatch Automation
en.summary: Using Python and n8n, an automated COA workflow was built to replace what used to be manual work: compiling shipment data, generating Certificates of Analysis (COA), and sending emails one by one. Once QA staff confirm the shipment data, the system automatically generates the COA, determines the correct recipients from the customer folder and contact list, adds the right CC recipients, and sends each COA to the right customer — cutting down repetitive manual work.
en.author: Hsieh Hsin-Hsi
en.problem_background: COA generation and dispatch used to involve many manual steps. QA staff first had to check the warehouse for shipment dates and quantities, enter the shipment data into a designated file, and produce the corresponding COA. After that, they still had to look up recipients for each customer, confirm who should be CC'd, compose the email, and send it out one at a time. As shipment batches or customer counts grew, this repetitive work consumed more and more time, and manual data entry, file sorting, or recipient mistakes could easily result in incorrect COA content or misdirected emails.
en.core_problem: How to standardize COA data compilation, document generation, customer matching, and email dispatch so QA staff spend less time on repetitive data entry and sending emails one by one.
en.solution:
The overall workflow is split into two parts:

COA generation automation: After QA staff confirm the shipment date and quantity, Python converts the shipment order into a system-readable format and compiles the shipment information into a designated file. The system then automatically generates the corresponding COA from the compiled data, eliminating manual document creation one at a time.

COA dispatch automation: A list is first built containing customer keywords, primary recipients, and CC recipients, and pending COAs are sorted by customer name. QA staff simply place the COAs in a designated folder, set the shipment date and sender for this run, and execute the n8n workflow. The system then automatically reads the files, identifies the matching customer, looks up the recipient list, and sends each COA to the correct customer and related contacts.

Use Python to convert the shipment order format.
Compile the shipment information into a designated data file.
Use Python to automatically generate the COA.
Sort the pending COAs by customer.
The system reads the customer-to-recipient mapping list.
Set the shipment date and sender before running.
Launch the n8n automation workflow.
The system identifies the customer and matches recipients.
The COA is automatically attached and the email is sent.

Supports batch processing across multiple customers and multiple COAs.
Automatically identifies the matching recipients by customer name.
Supports a primary recipient plus multiple CC recipients.
Automatically attaches the correct COA to the corresponding email.
Completes batch email dispatch through an n8n workflow.
Retains run parameters such as shipment date and sender, making it easy to reuse across different batches.

zh.title: LINEBOT 應用 : 推播功能與資料即時查詢
zh.summary: 建立兩種 LINE Bot 應用架構：方案一為 LINE Bot 搭配 n8n，依排程或文字關鍵字觸發，主動推播工作待辦提醒、會議提醒、每日工作回報，並可查詢班表與電話分機表；方案二為 LINE Bot 搭配雲端資料庫，透過互動式選單並整合 LLM 語言模型，讓使用者即時查詢產品異常排除等資料，系統自動回覆可能原因、對策建議與參考圖片。
zh.author: 謝欣錫
zh.status: 已完成雛型並於品保群組實際使用中
zh.problem_background: 品保單位過去仰賴人工在 LINE 群組手動整理並發送工作提醒、會議通知、每日工作回報，也需要有人隨時待命回覆班表、電話分機及產品異常排除等查詢。隨著查詢量增加，人工發送與逐一回覆的方式耗費大量時間，也容易發生提醒漏發或回覆延遲的情況。
zh.core_problem: 如何讓 LINE Bot 依排程或關鍵字自動推播提醒與回報，並讓使用者可透過文字或選單即時查詢班表、聯絡資訊及產品異常排除建議，減少人工整理與逐一回覆查詢的時間。
zh.solution:
整體規劃為兩個互補的方案：

方案一（LINE Bot 搭配 n8n，主動推播）：先在資料夾建立文字或圖片等原始資料（excel、word、jpg 等格式皆可），再透過 n8n 工作流設定判斷機制，依「定時」或「文字觸發」兩種方式運作。定時推播可用於工作待辦提醒、會議提醒及每日工作回報；文字觸發則用於查詢班表、電話分機表及表定工作事項，使用者只要在群組輸入指定格式的關鍵字（例如「問＋時間＋(課別/產品)＋(班別)」），機器人便會自動查詢並回覆結果。

方案二（LINE Bot 搭配雲端資料庫，資料即時查詢）：先將文字與圖片資料建立至雲端資料庫，使用者透過互動式選單（依產品類別，例如塑蓋、鋁蓋、爪蓋、PET 瓶）點選欲查詢的項目，並整合 LLM 語言模型於雲端資料庫中搜尋，自動回覆可能原因、對策建議，並附上參考圖片。

en.title: LINE Bot Application: Push Notifications & Real-Time Data Lookup
en.summary: Two complementary LINE Bot architectures were built. Scheme 1 pairs LINE Bot with n8n: triggered by a schedule or a text keyword, it proactively pushes to-do reminders, meeting reminders, and daily work reports, and can also look up shift schedules and phone extension lists. Scheme 2 pairs LINE Bot with a cloud database: through an interactive menu integrated with an LLM, users can look up information such as product defect troubleshooting in real time, and the system automatically replies with likely causes, recommended countermeasures, and reference photos.
en.author: Hsieh Hsin-Hsi
en.status: Prototype completed and already in active use within the QA group
en.problem_background: QA staff used to rely on manually compiling and posting work reminders, meeting notices, and daily work reports in LINE groups, and someone always had to be on standby to answer questions about shift schedules, phone extensions, and product defect troubleshooting. As the volume of questions grew, sending reminders and replying to each query manually consumed a large amount of time, and reminders were sometimes missed or replies delayed.
en.core_problem: How to let a LINE Bot automatically push reminders and reports on a schedule or by keyword, and let users look up shift schedules, contact information, and product defect troubleshooting advice in real time through text or a menu — reducing the time spent on manual compilation and answering queries one by one.
en.solution:
The overall plan consists of two complementary schemes:

Scheme 1 (LINE Bot + n8n, proactive push): Raw data (text or images, in formats such as Excel, Word, or JPG) is first set up in a folder. An n8n workflow is then configured with a decision mechanism that runs on either a "schedule" or a "text trigger." Scheduled pushes are used for to-do reminders, meeting reminders, and daily work reports; text-triggered pushes are used to look up shift schedules, phone extension lists, and scheduled tasks — a user simply types a keyword in the specified format in the group (e.g. "Ask + time + (section/product) + (shift)"), and the bot automatically looks it up and replies.

Scheme 2 (LINE Bot + cloud database, real-time lookup): Text and image data is first built into a cloud database. Users select what they want to look up through an interactive menu (by product category, e.g. plastic caps, aluminum caps, claw caps, PET bottles), and an LLM integrated into the bot searches the cloud database and automatically replies with likely causes, recommended countermeasures, and reference photos.

Scheme 2: The LINE Bot's integrated LLM searches the cloud database for matching data.
Scheme 2: The bot automatically replies with the search result, including likely causes, recommended countermeasures, and reference photos.

zh.title: AI 影片製作：多國語言旁白與字幕自動化
zh.summary: 將教育訓練／宣導影片的製作流程從人工錄製改為 AI 製作，以 AI 生成旁白與字幕，並可快速產出多國語言版本，原本需要真人錄製至少兩天以上的流程，大幅縮短影片產出時間。
zh.author: 陳芝妮（無菌二廠）
zh.problem_background: 職安衛中心過去製作教育訓練與宣導影片時，需要真人錄製旁白，再另外進行字幕聽打與校對，若需要多國語言版本，還要重新錄音、翻譯與後製，整支影片至少需要兩天以上的時間才能完成，遇到修改需求時也得重新走一次錄製流程。以印尼語教育訓練影片為例，過去需請翻譯人員將內容翻成印尼文，但翻譯人員對內容不熟悉，容易造成翻譯不完整、無法確實傳達，加上影片沒有字幕、翻譯時間也不好約，一支僅 40 分鐘的影片，錄製作業就需要 2 天；事前蒐集教育訓練所需的參考影片，也要花很長時間才能抓取完成。
zh.core_problem: 如何縮短影片旁白錄製與多國語言字幕製作所需的時間與人力，同時維持一定的影片品質與正確性。
zh.solution: 改以 AI 技術取代真人錄製，透過 AI 生成旁白語音、自動產生字幕，並將旁白與字幕轉換為多國語言版本，將原本至少兩天以上的錄製與後製流程，縮短為同一天內即可完成初版影片，且可同步輸出多國語言版本。改用 AI 後，在沒有用量限制的情況下，教材最快 1 天即可完成；若受用量限制，則約需一週。原本費時許久的參考影片蒐集作業，現在也只需 30 分鐘。

en.title: AI Video Production: Automated Multilingual Narration & Subtitles
en.summary: Shifted training and awareness video production from manual recording to AI-driven production: AI generates narration and subtitles and can quickly produce multilingual versions, cutting production time from at least two days of manual recording down to a fraction of that.
en.author: Chih-Ni Chen (Aseptic Plant 2)
en.problem_background: The EHS Center previously needed a real person to record narration for training and awareness videos, followed by separate subtitle transcription and proofreading. Multilingual versions required re-recording, translation, and post-production all over again, so a single video took at least two days to complete, and any revision meant repeating the whole recording process. For example, for an Indonesian-language training video, a translator had to translate the script into Indonesian, but the translator wasn't familiar with the content, which often led to incomplete or inaccurate translations. With no subtitles and translator availability hard to schedule, a video as short as 40 minutes took 2 full days to record. Gathering the reference footage needed for training beforehand also took a long time.
en.core_problem: How to cut the time and manpower needed for narration recording and multilingual subtitle production, while keeping video quality and accuracy intact.
en.solution: Replaced manual recording with AI: AI generates the narration voice, automatically produces subtitles, and converts narration and subtitles into multiple languages. What used to take at least two days of recording and post-production can now produce a first-cut video within the same day, with multilingual versions available at the same time. After switching to AI, with no usage limits, materials can be completed in as little as 1 day; when usage is capped, it takes about a week instead. Gathering reference footage, which used to take a long time, now takes only 30 minutes.

Generate narration audio with AI tools
AI automatically generates matching subtitles
Convert narration and subtitles into multiple languages
Finish editing and export the video

zh.title: 異常工作負荷風險分析

zh.author: 陳佳勳
zh.status: 已完成（2026 年 8–9 月，四廠名單皆已交付）
zh.region: 台灣（四廠：無菌一廠、無菌二廠、無菌三廠、自貿廠）
zh.problem_background: 依職業安全衛生法規，公司需推動異常工作負荷促發疾病預防計畫，定期找出過勞與腦心血管疾病的高風險員工。判定時要同時看三份資料：健康檢查的十年心血管風險、每月加班工時、過勞量表分數，再依官方指引對照出風險等級與建議處置。三份資料分屬不同 Excel 檔案，各廠的欄位順序與格式也不一樣。

en.title: Abnormal Workload Risk Analysis
en.summary: AI combined three datasets for 855 employees across four plants—10-year cardiovascular risk assessments, overtime hours and burnout questionnaire scores—classified risk automatically according to official guidelines, and produced health management lists that can be used directly to schedule interviews and follow-up. Analysis time per plant dropped from 3–4 days to under 1 hour.
en.author: 陳佳勳
en.status: Completed (Aug–Sep 2026; lists delivered for all four plants)
en.region: Taiwan (four plants: Aseptic Plants 1, 2 and 3, and the Free Trade Zone Plant)
en.problem_background: Under occupational safety and health regulations, the company must run a program to prevent diseases triggered by abnormal workload, regularly identifying employees at high risk of overwork and cerebrovascular/cardiovascular disease. Each judgment requires three datasets together—10-year cardiovascular risk from health checkups, monthly overtime hours and burnout questionnaire scores—matched against official guidelines to determine risk level and recommended action. The three datasets are separate Excel files, and column order and formats differ between plants.
en.core_problem: Nurses previously compared the three datasets record by record in Excel and assigned risk levels manually, taking 3–4 days per plant. A full round for four plants took a long time and was prone to matching and classification errors. Data preparation ate into the time nurses needed for interviews and follow-up.
en.solution: The nurse provided the three source datasets and official guidelines. AI first read the original guideline text to confirm the classification criteria, then merged the three datasets by employee ID, automatically judged workload and cardiovascular risk levels, matched each employee to a recommended action, and produced a health management list split into color-coded tabs. AI then re-checked every record with a separate, independent calculation. Once the first plant was confirmed, the logic and list format were fixed and reused for the other plants.
process: The nurse prepares each plant's three source datasets (10-year cardiovascular risk, overtime hours, burnout questionnaire) and the Guidelines for Preventing Diseases Triggered by Abnormal Workload
AI reads the original guideline text and compiles thresholds for overtime, personal fatigue, work fatigue and cardiovascular risk, confirmed by the nurse
AI merges the three datasets by employee ID, mapping each plant's different column layout by column name, without ever modifying the original files
AI automatically judges workload level and risk level and matches each to a recommended action
AI produces the health management list in Excel and re-checks every record with an independent recalculation
The nurse reviews the results, handles borderline and incomplete cases, and uses the confirmed list for interviews and follow-up

zh.title: AI 職安衛教育訓練教材製作

en.title: AI-Assisted EHS Training Material Production
en.summary: EHS training content used to be dense, text-heavy, and dry. With GPT's help, the key points were reorganized, the way ideas were expressed was reworked, and the content was turned into visual, easy-to-follow materials. Turning complex regulations and safety knowledge into more intuitive images and explanations not only makes the materials more readable, it also boosts employees' willingness to learn and helps them remember the content, making EHS training more engaging and efficient.
en.author: Wen-Chen Lin (Aseptic Plant 2)
en.problem_background: EHS training materials used to be mostly plain text — dense and dry, making them hard for employees to read and absorb. Complex regulatory text and safety knowledge were also difficult to translate into explanations that were easy to understand on the shop floor.
en.core_problem: How to turn complex regulations and safety knowledge into materials employees can read and understand easily, boosting their willingness to learn and how well they retain the content.
en.solution: Used GPT to help reorganize the key points of the training materials, rework how the content was expressed, and produce illustrated awareness posters — turning EHS training content that used to be mostly text into more intuitive images and explanations.

ai_usage: Organizing the key points of training content into clearer, simpler explanations
Converting text-heavy regulations and safety knowledge into illustrated awareness posters

results: Produced multiple illustrated EHS awareness materials covering defensive driving, heat stroke prevention, fall prevention, chemical hazard prevention, and anti-entanglement.
Can quickly turn real site photos into hazard annotations and improvement mock-ups.
Materials shifted from plain text explanations to image-driven, easier-to-read awareness posters.

zh.title: 集團 AI 推廣管理 Dashboard（THC AI Enablement Platform）
zh.summary: 建立集團層級的 AI 推廣管理平台，統一追蹤各單位 AI 導入的成熟度（L0～L5）、AI 專案與案例進度、AI 人才盤點、API 使用成本，讓推動 AI 的單位與管理層能在同一個地方掌握全集團的 AI 推動狀況，而不必分散在各單位的報表與口頭回報中，長期目標是發展成集團的 AI Operating System（AIOS）。
zh.author: 徐馬克
zh.region: 集團（含台灣、大陸總部、東南亞總部及各分支據點）
zh.problem_background: 集團各單位陸續推動 AI 應用，但這些進度分散在不同單位、不同格式的報表與會議紀錄中，管理層難以即時掌握全集團的 AI 推動全貌：哪些單位已經導入、導入到什麼程度、有哪些專案與案例正在進行、AI 相關人才配置狀況如何、API 使用成本花費多少，都需要額外彙整才能回答。
zh.core_problem: 如何用一個統一的平台，讓集團管理層與各單位可以即時查看 AI 推動的成熟度、專案與案例進度、人才配置與 API 成本，取代分散、人工彙整的回報方式。
zh.solution:
建立以 Next.js + Supabase 開發、部署於 Vercel 的 Dashboard 平台，將 AI 推動狀況拆成五個成熟度等級（L0 未啟動～L5 可複製），並整合以下管理模組：
- AI 推動管理：Dashboard 總覽、單位管理、AI 專案管理、AI 案例管理、需求管理
- AI 資源管理：AI 人才管理、API 成本管理
- 系統管理：部門管理、使用者管理（採白名單機制，不開放公開註冊）

首頁 Dashboard 提供 AI 成熟度平均、專案與案例總數、導入單位數、本月 API 花費等關鍵指標，並以圓餅圖與長條圖呈現整體與各地區的成熟度分布，讓使用者可依月份、地區篩選查看。
process: 盤點集團各單位 AI 推動現況，定義 L0～L5 的 AI 成熟度分級標準
設計資料庫 Schema 與 RBAC 權限模型（Admin／Viewer 角色搭配 Row Level Security）
開發 Dashboard 首頁與各功能模組（單位管理、AI 專案管理、AI 案例管理、AI 人才管理、API 成本管理）
部署至 Vercel，串接 Supabase 作為後端資料庫與身份驗證服務
後續依各單位回饋持續擴充功能模組（如 Prompt Library、AI Agent Marketplace）

en.title: Group AI Adoption Management Dashboard (THC AI Enablement Platform)
en.summary: A group-wide AI adoption management platform that tracks each unit's AI maturity level (L0 through L5), AI project and case progress, AI talent inventory, and API usage cost in one place — so units driving AI adoption and management no longer need to rely on scattered reports and verbal updates. The long-term goal is to evolve it into the group's AI Operating System (AIOS).
en.author: Mark Hsu
en.region: Group-wide (Taiwan, Mainland HQ, Southeast Asia HQ, and other sites)
en.problem_background: As different units across the group roll out their own AI initiatives, progress ends up scattered across different reports, formats, and meeting notes. Management has no easy way to see the full group-wide picture of AI adoption: which units have adopted AI, how far along they are, what projects and cases are underway, how AI-related talent is allocated, and how much is being spent on API usage all require manual aggregation to answer.
en.core_problem: How to give group management and individual units a single, unified platform to see AI maturity, project and case progress, talent allocation, and API cost in real time — replacing scattered, manually compiled reporting.
en.solution:
Built a dashboard platform with Next.js + Supabase, deployed on Vercel, that breaks down AI adoption into five maturity levels (L0 Not Started through L5 Replicable) and integrates the following modules:
- AI Adoption Management: Dashboard overview, Unit Management, AI Project Management, AI Case Management, Requirement Management
- AI Resource Management: AI Talent Management, API Cost Management
- System Management: Department Management, User Management (invite-only whitelist, no public sign-up)

The home Dashboard surfaces key metrics such as average AI maturity, total projects and cases, number of units onboarded, and this month's API spend, and visualizes overall and regional maturity distribution with pie and bar charts, filterable by month and region.
process: Surveyed the current state of AI adoption across group units and defined the L0–L5 AI maturity grading standard
Designed the database schema and RBAC permission model (Admin/Viewer roles with Row Level Security)
Built the Dashboard home page and core feature modules (Unit Management, AI Project Management, AI Case Management, AI Talent Management, API Cost Management)
Deployed to Vercel, integrating Supabase as the backend database and authentication service
Continuing to expand feature modules (e.g. Prompt Library, AI Agent Marketplace) based on feedback from each unit

zh.title: 訂單拆分工作台
zh.summary: 針對混合多家公司訂單的 PDF，自動辨識每頁公司名稱並分組，經人工確認後一鍵拆分下載，取代逐頁人工比對整理的作業方式。
zh.author: 徐馬克
zh.region: 台灣
zh.problem_background: 公司訂單常以單一 PDF 混合多家客戶的訂單頁面，過去需人工逐頁翻閱、辨識公司名稱，再手動複製分割成各公司獨立檔案，耗時且容易出錯。
zh.core_problem: 缺少一套能自動辨識頁面所屬公司並分組整理的工具，人工比對效率低，也難以確保拆分結果正確無誤。
zh.solution: 建立訂單拆分工作台，只擷取每頁頁首的公司名稱區域送 OCR 辨識，系統自動彙整同公司頁面，使用者逐家確認無誤後才可匯出，確保正確性。
process: 上傳訂單 PDF（上限 50MB、100 頁）
系統擷取每頁頁首區域，呼叫 Google Vision OCR 辨識公司名稱
依辨識結果自動合併同公司頁面，顯示縮圖與信心狀態
使用者逐家公司確認或修正辨識結果
確認完成後，個別下載 PDF 或一次下載 ZIP

en.title: Order PDF Splitter
en.summary: Automatically identifies the company name on each page of a mixed-company order PDF, groups matching pages, and lets users confirm before a one-click split and download—replacing manual page-by-page sorting.
en.author: Mark Hsu
en.problem_background: Company order PDFs often mix order pages from multiple client companies into a single file. Staff previously had to manually flip through every page to identify the company name, then copy and split pages into separate files by hand—slow and error-prone.
en.core_problem: There was no tool to automatically recognize which company each page belongs to and group pages accordingly, making manual sorting inefficient and hard to verify for accuracy.
en.solution: Built an order-splitting workbench that sends only the company-name region at the top of each page for OCR recognition. The system automatically groups pages by company, and users confirm each group before exporting to ensure accuracy.
process: Upload an order PDF (up to 50 MB, 100 pages)
The system crops the header region of each page and calls Google Vision OCR to recognize the company name
Pages are automatically grouped by company based on the recognition results, with thumbnails and confidence status shown
The user reviews and confirms or corrects each company's grouping
Once confirmed, download the PDF for a single company or a ZIP with all files

en.title: Indoor Renovation Acceptance & Defect Improvement Management System
en.summary: Add defects with phone photos and centrally track improvement, re-inspection, sign-off, and case closure.
en.author: Yan-Hui Chen
en.problem_background: On-site acceptance defects used to be scattered across LINE groups, photos, and meeting notes, with different parties holding different versions, making it hard to centrally track improvement and re-inspection progress.
en.core_problem: Defect photos, descriptions, improvement reports, and sign-off records lacked a single source of management, while on-site staff needed to be able to take photos and fill in records quickly on their phones.
en.solution: Built a responsive web system that centrally manages acceptance items, defect photos, improvement reports, role-based sign-off, and Word document export, with all records stored in a database.

zh.title: 訂單與財務智慧分析平台（THC Report）
zh.summary: 整合集團訂單資料（OCR 辨識的紙本／PDF 訂單、SAP 直接匯出的訂單 Excel）與財務資料（月度損益、季度合併財務報表），建立一個管理層可以直接查看銷售、毛利、客戶與產品結構的儀表板平台，取代原本分散在各業務單位 Excel、紙本與口頭回報的彙整方式。
zh.author: 徐喬奎
zh.status: 正式上線，持續迭代開發中
zh.region: 集團（台灣總部各業務部門、大陸、東南亞各分支據點）
zh.problem_background: 集團訂單資料原本分散在各業務單位（國內業務、業三部出口、飲料代工、東南亞、大陸等）各自的紙本或 PDF 訂單、Excel 報表中，財務數據則來自每月／每季的損益與合併財報文件。管理層若要掌握集團整體的銷售、毛利、客戶或區域表現，需要向各單位分別索取報表再手動彙整比對，耗時且容易因格式、幣別、匯率換算不一致而失真。
zh.core_problem: 如何在同一個平台整合來自不同來源（OCR 辨識的紙本訂單、SAP 直接匯出的訂單 Excel、季度合併財報）、不同幣別、不同業務單位分類邏輯的資料，讓管理層可以即時查看集團與各單位的訂單、客戶、產品、毛利表現，不必依賴人工彙整。
zh.solution:
以 Cloudflare Workers + D1 建立的訂單與財務分析平台，分為三大模組：
- 訂單分析（依業務單位）：國內業務、業三部（出口）、飲料代工、東南亞、大陸各自的 Dashboard，透過 OCR 辨識訂單 PDF 自動建立結構化訂單資料，並依各業務單位幣別特性採用「不跨幣別加總」或「換算基準幣別後加總」兩種安全的金額呈現邏輯，避免不同幣別的金額被誤加總
- 集團訂單分析：直接讀取 SAP 訂單匯出 Excel，建立集團總覽、區域分析、客戶分析等頁面，用公司匯率設定將各幣別換算成報表幣別後彙總，並提供客戶價值矩陣、重點客戶排行榜等進階分析
- 財報分析：解析月度損益 Excel 與季度合併財務報表，建立損益分析、趨勢分析、損益結構、合併財務總覽等頁面
process: 依各業務單位／集團訂單／財報三大模組分別設計資料表結構與匯入邏輯
訂單 PDF 上傳後，透過 OCR 辨識並比對既有客戶／產品資料，自動建立或更新訂單，並標示疑似重複的訂單供人工確認
SAP 集團訂單 Excel 上傳後，依欄位規則解析並比對地區、部門、公司代號主檔，直接寫入資料庫，用來源編號避免重複匯入
建立公司匯率設定機制，將各幣別訂單換算為報表幣別後計算銷售金額與加權毛利率
依管理層回饋逐步擴充頁面（如客戶分析的客戶價值矩陣、重點客戶排行榜）並持續修正資料正確性
每次新增功能皆先在 Cloudflare Workers 的 preview 版本上，用測試帳號完整驗證資料正確性後才部署到正式環境

en.title: Order & Financial Intelligence Platform (THC Report)
en.summary: Integrates group-wide order data (paper/PDF orders recognized via OCR, order Excel files exported directly from SAP) with financial data (monthly P&L, quarterly consolidated financial reports) into a single dashboard where management can directly view sales, margin, customer and product structure — replacing the previous approach of gathering scattered Excel files, paper reports and verbal updates from each business unit.
en.author: Chiao-Kuei Hsu
en.status: Live in production, under continuous iteration
en.region: Group-wide (Taiwan HQ business units, China, and Southeast Asia branch sites)
en.problem_background: Group order data was originally scattered across each business unit's own paper/PDF orders and Excel reports (domestic sales, Export/BU3, beverage OEM, Southeast Asia, China, etc.), while financial figures came from monthly/quarterly P&L and consolidated financial report files. For management to understand group-wide sales, margin, customer, or regional performance, reports had to be requested separately from each unit and reconciled manually — a slow process prone to distortion from inconsistent formats, currencies, and exchange-rate conversions.
en.core_problem: How to integrate data from different sources (OCR-recognized paper orders, SAP-exported order Excel files, quarterly consolidated financial reports), different currencies, and different business-unit classification logic into a single platform, so management can view group- and unit-level orders, customers, products, and margin performance in real time without relying on manual consolidation.
en.solution:
An order and financial analysis platform built on Cloudflare Workers + D1, organized into three modules:
- Order analysis by business unit: separate dashboards for domestic sales, Export/BU3, beverage OEM, Southeast Asia, and China, with structured order data auto-created via OCR recognition of order PDFs. Depending on each unit's currency characteristics, amounts are shown either without cross-currency summation or converted to a base currency before summation, avoiding incorrectly summed cross-currency totals
- Group order analysis: reads SAP order export Excel files directly, powering group overview, regional analysis, and customer analysis pages that convert each currency to the reporting currency using configured company exchange rates, plus advanced analyses such as a customer value matrix and key-customer ranking
- Financial report analysis: parses monthly P&L Excel files and quarterly consolidated financial reports into profit analysis, trend analysis, P&L structure, and consolidated financial overview pages
process: Designed separate table structures and import logic for the three modules: business-unit orders, group orders, and financial reports

After an order PDF is uploaded, OCR recognizes the content and matches it against existing customer/product records, automatically creating or updating orders and flagging suspected duplicates for manual confirmation

After a SAP group order Excel file is uploaded, fields are parsed and matched against region, department, and company code master data, then written directly to the database, using a source reference number to prevent duplicate imports
Built a company exchange-rate configuration mechanism to convert orders in different currencies into the reporting currency before computing sales amounts and weighted gross margin
Incrementally expanded pages based on management feedback (e.g., the customer value matrix and key-customer ranking in customer analysis) while continuously correcting data accuracy
Every new feature is first validated end-to-end on a Cloudflare Workers preview version with a test account before being deployed to production

zh.author: 徐喬奎
zh.region: 台灣

en.title: Packaging Carbon Reduction Calculator
en.summary: Lets sales reps enter packaging improvement data themselves to calculate carbon reduction (tCO2e), replacing manual coefficient lookups and conversions.
en.author: Chiao-Kuei Hsu
en.problem_background: Sales reps are often asked by customers how much carbon a packaging improvement (e.g. bottle lightweighting) would reduce. This used to require manually looking up coefficients and applying formulas, which was slow, error-prone, and made it hard to respond to customers quickly.
en.core_problem: There was no tool letting sales reps calculate carbon reduction themselves, and the coefficients for common materials were scattered across different documents.
en.solution: Built an online calculator supporting two scenarios, "lightweighting" and "material/process substitution", with built-in coefficients (PET, HDPE, rPET, label printing) that can be selected directly or overridden with custom values.

Enter weight, usage amount, shipment quantity, etc.; coefficients can use built-in values or custom input
The system automatically calculates the carbon reduction (tCO2e) with a calculation breakdown

zh.summary: 讓發言人不用手動開好幾個網站查詢，一鍵產生大盤指數、宏全股價、匯率、原油期貨、美股道瓊等固定格式的每日報告文字，複製貼給總裁。
zh.author: 徐喬奎
zh.region: 台灣
zh.problem_background: 發言人每天要準備一份固定格式的市場報告給總裁參考，內容包含大盤指數、宏全股價、匯率、原油期貨、美股道瓊等數字。過去要分別開好幾個網站查詢、手動抄寫並排版成固定格式文字，過程繁瑣且容易抄錯數字或漏抄。
zh.core_problem: 缺少一套能自動彙整多個資料來源、按固定格式產生報告文字的工具，發言人每天要重複做同樣的查詢與排版工作。
zh.solution: 建立一個網頁小工具，透過 GitHub Actions 排程在每個交易日固定時間自動抓取大盤指數、宏全股價、匯率、原油期貨、美股道瓊等資料並組成報告文字，發言人開啟頁面就能直接複製貼上；也提供「重新讀取」按鈕即時重新抓取所有來源的最新資料。

19:30 再抓取大盤指數、宏全股價、原油期貨、美股道瓊等其餘資料，組成報告文字並存檔
發言人開啟頁面看到當日預先產生好的報告文字，可直接複製或編輯後使用
需要更即時的資料時按「重新讀取」，透過 Cloudflare Worker 即時向各資料來源重新查詢

en.title: Spokesperson Daily Market Report Tool
en.summary: Lets the company spokesperson generate a fixed-format daily report text (TAIEX, Hon Chuan stock price, forex, crude oil futures, Dow Jones) with one click, instead of manually checking multiple websites, to paste directly to the President.
en.author: Chiao-Kuei Hsu
en.problem_background: Every day the spokesperson has to prepare a fixed-format market report for the President, covering the TAIEX index, Hon Chuan's (9939) stock price, exchange rates, crude oil futures, and the Dow Jones. This used to require opening several websites, manually copying numbers, and formatting them into a fixed text layout — tedious and prone to transcription errors or missed figures.
en.core_problem: There was no tool to automatically aggregate multiple data sources into a fixed-format report text; the spokesperson had to repeat the same lookup-and-formatting work every day.
en.solution: Built a web tool that uses a scheduled GitHub Actions job to automatically fetch the TAIEX, Hon Chuan stock price, exchange rates, crude oil futures, and Dow Jones data at fixed times on trading days, and assembles them into report text — the spokesperson can just open the page and copy it. A "Reload" button is also provided to re-fetch the latest data from all sources in real time.
process: GitHub Actions saves a forex snapshot at 14:00 Taipei time on trading days
At 19:30, it fetches the TAIEX, Hon Chuan stock price, crude oil futures, Dow Jones, and other data, and assembles them into the report text
The spokesperson opens the page and sees that day's pre-generated report text, ready to copy or edit
For more up-to-date data, clicking "Reload" re-queries all data sources in real time via a Cloudflare Worker

features.name: Fixed-format report text
features.desc: Automatically assembles a ready-to-copy daily report text in a fixed layout, covering the TAIEX index, Hon Chuan stock price, forex, crude oil, and the Dow Jones

features.desc: Crude oil futures show quotes from both Taiwan's Bureau of Energy and cnyes.com side by side, matching the spokesperson's existing habit of cross-checking both sources

features.name: Independent fault tolerance per source

ai_usage: Helped locate usable endpoints from public data sources such as TWSE, the Bureau of Energy, and cnyes.com, and designed the corresponding fetch logic
Diagnosed the root causes of real-time fetch failures (e.g. transient Cloudflare edge errors, inconsistent response formats across sources), and designed retry and error-handling logic accordingly
Assisted with developing, deploying, and debugging the Cloudflare Worker and the GitHub Actions schedule

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.desc: Requirements clarification, data source discovery, development, and debugging

tools.name: GitHub Actions
tools.desc: Scheduled daily data fetching and archiving

tools.name: Cloudflare Workers
tools.desc: Data proxy powering the real-time reload feature

tools.name: GitHub Pages
tools.desc: Site deployment

results: The spokesperson no longer has to manually open multiple websites and copy numbers — the page already has that day's report text ready
After switching crude oil quotes to the official and cnyes.com sources, the earlier issue of a third-party API being stuck on a stale cache no longer occurs
With independent fault tolerance per data source, one source temporarily failing no longer makes the whole report unusable

value.name: For the spokesperson
value.desc: Saves the daily time spent looking up, copying, and formatting numbers, and reduces the risk of transcription errors

value.name: For the company
value.desc: Standardizes the report format and data sources, reducing information gaps caused by manual work

extensions: Can be extended to fetch more public data that currently needs manual daily aggregation (e.g. other exchange rates, commodity prices)
The data-fetching and fault-tolerance architecture can be reused for other internal tools that need to aggregate multiple data sources on a fixed schedule
limitations: Trading volume/value figures follow TWSE's public statistical basis, which can differ from manually looked-up numbers by 2-4%
Both crude oil quotes (Bureau of Energy, cnyes.com) are daily reference prices updated once a day, not tick-by-tick real-time quotes

Some data sources (e.g. TWSE's realtime quote system, cnyes.com) are internal endpoints used by those sites rather than official public APIs, so format changes on their end may require the fetch logic to be updated accordingly
en.success_key: Instead of replacing the spokesperson's existing habit of cross-checking both the Bureau of Energy and cnyes.com crude oil quotes with a single source, the tool kept both sources displayed side by side — fitting the existing way of working rather than forcing a change of habit.

zh.title: SDS 化學品申報總表一鍵更新系統
zh.summary: 自動讀取 SDS 與年度採購資料，一鍵產生成分換算、申報判斷及既有化學物質比對表，降低人工整理時間與計算錯誤。
zh.author: 陳煜勳
zh.region: 台灣
zh.problem_background: 新增或更新 SDS 時，需人工查找成分、CAS 號碼與濃度，再搭配年度採購重量計算申報量；資料分散且步驟繁複。
zh.core_problem: 人工抄錄與計算耗時、容易出錯，且不同料號、登錄號碼與 CAS 的彙整規則複雜，難以快速追溯公式與確認申報門檻。
zh.solution: 建立本機一鍵更新工具，讀取 sds 資料夾及年度申報檔，依料號擷取最高成分比例、計算換算重量，再產出申報與既有物質比對結果。
process: 將 PDF 或 Excel 格式的 SDS 放入 sds 資料夾。
雙擊「一鍵更新總表.cmd」，重新讀取全部資料。
系統比對料號、擷取 SDS 成分及最高濃度。
依年度採購重量產生三張結果工作表，供人員複核。

features.desc: 支援文字型 PDF、XLSX 與 XLSM SDS。

features.name: 自動換算
features.desc: 以採購重量乘最高成分比例計算化學品重量。

features.desc: 依 CAS 與人工核對清單標示比對狀態。

ai_usage: 協助拆解需求、建立規格與釐清料號、登錄號碼、CAS 的彙整邏輯。
協助產生程式與測試案例，檢查公式、邊界值及異常資料處理。

results: 實際處理 9 份 SDS，產出 42 筆料號成分資料與 21 筆申報判斷資料。

limitations: 掃描型、加密或版面特殊的 PDF 可能無法正確擷取，需人工確認。
SDS 料號須能與年度採購資料正確對應；無效或保密 CAS 需人工處理。
產出結果仍應由熟悉法規的人員確認後再用於正式申報。
zh.success_key: 先明確定義料號、登錄號碼及 CAS 的彙整優先順序，保留 Excel 公式供追溯，並以實際 SDS、邊界值與異常資料持續驗證。

en.title: SDS Chemical Declaration Summary One-Click Update System
en.summary: Automatically reads SDS and annual procurement data to generate composition conversion, declaration determination, and existing-chemical-substance comparison tables in one click, reducing manual data organizing time and calculation errors.
en.author: Yu-Hsun Chen
en.problem_background: When adding or updating an SDS, staff had to manually look up composition, CAS numbers, and concentrations, then combine them with annual procurement weights to calculate declaration quantities; the data was scattered and the steps were tedious.
en.core_problem: Manual transcription and calculation were time-consuming and error-prone, and the aggregation rules across material codes, registration numbers, and CAS numbers were complex, making it hard to quickly trace formulas or confirm declaration thresholds.
en.solution: Built a local one-click update tool that reads the SDS folder and the annual declaration file, extracts the highest composition ratio by material code, calculates the converted weight, and produces declaration and existing-substance comparison results.
process: Place SDS files in PDF or Excel format into the sds folder.
Double-click "一鍵更新總表.cmd" (One-Click Update Summary) to reload all data.
The system matches material codes and extracts SDS composition and the highest concentration.
Three result worksheets are generated based on annual procurement weight for staff to review.

features.name: Multi-format extraction
features.desc: Supports text-based PDF, XLSX, and XLSM SDS files.

features.name: Automatic conversion
features.desc: Calculates chemical weight by multiplying procurement weight by the highest composition ratio.

features.name: Declaration determination
features.desc: Aggregates across material codes and flags declarations required above 100 kg.

features.name: Existing substance comparison
features.desc: Marks comparison status against a manually verified list using CAS numbers.

ai_usage: Helped break down requirements, define specifications, and clarify the aggregation logic across material codes, registration numbers, and CAS numbers.
Helped generate code and test cases to check formulas, boundary values, and handling of abnormal data.

tools.name: Python
tools.desc: Parses SDS files, integrates annual data, and runs the calculation workflow.

tools.name: openpyxl
tools.desc: Reads and writes Excel files while preserving traceable formulas and sheet formatting.

tools.name: pypdf
tools.desc: Extracts product and composition information from text-based PDFs.

tools.name: Windows batch file
tools.desc: Provides a one-click entry point users can run by double-clicking.

results: Processed 9 SDS files in practice, producing 42 material-composition records and 21 declaration-determination records.
Generated three worksheets: "Summary," "Declaration Determination," and "Existing Chemical Substance Comparison."
Existing substance comparison results: 12 "Yes," 7 "Pending manual lookup," and 2 "Cannot be matched by CAS."
All 9 automated tests passed, with zero formula errors found in the scan.

value.name: For the business unit
value.desc: Turns repetitive transcription and calculation into a one-click update, shortening data organizing time.

value.name: For users
value.desc: Formulas remain directly traceable, making declaration and pending items easier to review.

value.name: For the company
value.desc: Reduces the risk of missed declarations and calculation errors, and establishes a reusable standard process.

extensions: Can be extended to batch aggregation and threshold determination for other years, plants, or chemical inventories.
Can add OCR for scanned PDFs, anomaly notifications, or import formats for declaration systems.
limitations: Scanned, encrypted, or unusually formatted PDFs may not be extracted correctly and require manual verification.
SDS material codes must correctly correspond to annual procurement data; invalid or trade-secret CAS numbers require manual handling.
Output results should still be confirmed by staff familiar with the regulations before being used for official declarations.
en.success_key: Clearly defining the aggregation priority of material codes, registration numbers, and CAS numbers up front, keeping Excel formulas traceable, and continuously validating with real SDS data, boundary values, and abnormal cases.

en.title: THC Group AI License Requirement Calculator
en.summary: A quick Q&A tool that assesses a unit's AI needs and automatically recommends the appropriate number of users and license seats, helping managers allocate resources fairly.
en.author: 徐喬奎
en.problem_background: AI licenses are often allocated based on headcount or subjective judgment, with no consistent standard — leading to over- or under-provisioning and requests that are hard to justify to management.
en.core_problem: How can each unit quickly quantify its AI usage needs and translate usage frequency, time saved, applicability, and tool patterns into a defensible license recommendation?
en.solution: Built a public online calculator that scores four weighted work-need dimensions, maps the score to a recommended user count by tier, and estimates license seats using a multi-AI usage multiplier.

zh.author: 徐喬奎
zh.problem_background: 過去缺乏有效率的飲料產品管理平台，且傳統搜尋功能效能低落，難以快速查找目標商品；同時也缺乏針對不同使用者（如訪客與管理員）的完善存取與安全控管機制。
zh.core_problem: 需要一個能支援毫秒級搜尋、多國語系無縫切換，並能嚴格區分一般使用者與管理員權限的雲端整合系統，且必須確保在第三方搜尋引擎失效時有備援方案。
zh.solution: 採用 React + Vite 構建前端，整合 Firebase 處理 SSO 身分驗證與 Firestore 資料儲存，並導入 Algolia 達成極速全文混合式搜尋。同時設計了白名單與自動防閃屏的安全授權機制。
process: 使用者透過 Google OAuth 進行單一登入 (SSO)。
系統在背景驗證信箱是否具備白名單或管理員 (admin) 權限。
驗證成功後無縫導向首頁，自動載入 Firestore 產品資料或透過 Algolia 進行關鍵字搜尋。

features.name: 混合式搜尋引擎
features.desc: 整合 Firestore 原生查詢與 Algolia 全文檢索，具備優雅降級(Fallback)保護。

features.name: 角色權限控管
features.desc: 攔截並驗證 Google 登入者的權限，阻擋非白名單用戶。

features.name: 產品管理與展示
features.desc: 支援產品的新增、編輯、批次刪除，包含品牌、價格與容量網格化展示。

features.name: 多國語系支援
features.desc: 整合 i18n，讓前端介面與飲料分類可即時切換語言。

tools.name: React & Vite
tools.desc: 作為前端核心框架與極速建置工具。

tools.name: Firebase (Auth & Firestore)
tools.desc: 處理 Google 登入、權限控管與雲端資料庫儲存。

tools.name: Algolia
tools.desc: 提供企業級的毫秒全文檢索與容錯搜尋能力。

tools.name: Tailwind CSS
tools.desc: 建構具備現代感與響應式(RWD)的 UI 介面設計。

results: 成功建置具備毫秒級回應的全文檢索產品型錄。
解決了授權跳轉的閃屏問題，提供流暢的白名單登入體驗。
實作了友善的防抖(Debounce)搜尋、自動置頂與流暢的分頁機制。

value.name: 對業務單位
value.desc: 能快速查找與展示飲料產品，大幅提升行銷與展演效率。

value.name: 對公司
value.desc: 建立了一套前端架構乾淨、高安全性（API 金鑰抽離）的內部產品管理平台標準。

extensions: 可直接延伸作為公司內部其他產品線（如食品、周邊）的標準化型錄模板。
白名單授權機制與 Algolia 混合搜尋架構，可輕易複製到其他需要高效檢索的專案。
limitations: Algolia 具有搜尋額度限制，系統已內建 Firestore 本地搜尋作為備援機制以節省流量。
目前僅針對特定的管理員信箱提供完整的後台修改與刪除權限。
zh.success_key:
- 前端架構乾淨，確實將第三方 API Key 安全抽離至環境變數管理。
- 妥善處理了非同步權限檢查的順序，以及 Firebase 與 Algolia 之間的容錯與備援機制。

en.title: Modern Beverage Product Catalog & Access Management System
en.summary: A modern beverage product catalog platform with high-speed full-text search, multi-language support, Google OAuth-based access control, and real-time database updates.
en.author: 徐喬奎
en.problem_background: There was no efficient platform for managing beverage product data, and traditional search performed poorly, making it hard to find target products quickly. There was also no proper access control mechanism to distinguish between guest and admin users.
en.core_problem: The team needed a cloud-integrated system that supports millisecond-level search, seamless multi-language switching, and strict separation of regular user and admin permissions, with a fallback in case the third-party search engine fails.
en.solution: Built the frontend with React + Vite, integrated Firebase for SSO authentication and Firestore data storage, and adopted Algolia for ultra-fast hybrid full-text search. Also designed a whitelist mechanism and flicker-free authorization flow.
process: Users sign in via Google OAuth single sign-on (SSO).
The system verifies in the background whether the email is on the whitelist or has admin permissions.
Once verified, users are seamlessly redirected to the homepage, which automatically loads Firestore product data or searches via Algolia.

features.name: Hybrid Search Engine
features.desc: Combines native Firestore queries with Algolia full-text search, with graceful fallback protection.

features.name: Role-Based Access Control
features.desc: Intercepts and verifies Google sign-in permissions, blocking non-whitelisted users.

features.name: Product Management & Display
features.desc: Supports adding, editing, and batch deleting products, with a grid view of brand, price, and volume.

features.name: Multi-Language Support
features.desc: Integrated i18n lets the frontend UI and beverage categories switch languages instantly.

tools.name: React & Vite
tools.desc: Core frontend framework and ultra-fast build tool.

tools.name: Firebase (Auth & Firestore)
tools.desc: Handles Google sign-in, access control, and cloud database storage.

tools.name: Algolia
tools.desc: Provides enterprise-grade millisecond full-text search with fault tolerance.

tools.name: Tailwind CSS
tools.desc: Builds a modern, responsive (RWD) UI design.

results: Successfully built a full-text search product catalog with millisecond response times.
Resolved the flicker issue during authorization redirects, delivering a smooth whitelist sign-in experience.
Implemented debounced search, auto-scroll-to-top, and smooth pagination.

value.name: For Business Units
value.desc: Enables fast lookup and display of beverage products, greatly improving marketing and presentation efficiency.

value.name: For the Company
value.desc: Established a clean, high-security (API keys isolated) standard for internal product management platforms.

extensions: Can be directly extended as a standardized catalog template for other internal product lines (e.g., food, merchandise).
The whitelist authorization mechanism and Algolia hybrid search architecture can easily be replicated in other projects that need efficient search.
limitations: Algolia has search quota limits; the system includes a local Firestore search fallback to conserve quota.
Currently only specific admin emails are granted full backend edit and delete permissions.
en.success_key:
- The frontend architecture is clean, with third-party API keys properly isolated into environment variables.
- Carefully handled the order of asynchronous permission checks, as well as fault tolerance and fallback between Firebase and Algolia.

zh.title: 宏全國際集團建廠專案資料庫
zh.summary: 整合 KIIC 廠追加減、設計優化與宏信廠驗收資料，讓團隊能以廠區、工程分類、金額、照片及影片快速查閱與追蹤。
zh.unit_request: 宏全國際集團建廠／廠務團隊
zh.author: 馬崇耀
zh.region: 印尼、泰國、台灣
zh.problem_background: 建廠追加減報告、設計檢討、驗收文字與現場照片分散，跨廠區資料容易混用，新進同仁也不易理解工程變更原因。
zh.core_problem: 如何保留原始佐證並把複雜工程資料轉為可搜尋、可分流、可理解的團隊知識庫，同時避免未登入者直接瀏覽內容。
zh.solution: 建置具帳密保護的全端網站，將 KIIC 與宏信資料分流；以工程總帳、驗收卡、照片／影片瀏覽器及設計方針整理資訊。
process: 彙整七份 KIIC 追加減報告、設計優化結論與宏信驗收文字、照片及影片。
建立統一資料結構，依廠區、工程類別、主題、金額與報告次序整理。
建置登入、廠區選擇、查詢篩選、媒體瀏覽與留言等網站功能。
以桌面、手機及正式站反覆驗證後發布，持續依現場回饋調整介面。

features.name: KIIC 工程總帳
features.desc: 依工程分類、金額與報告次序查詢追加減項目及原因。

features.name: 設計優化方針
features.desc: 收錄 33 條建廠經驗與白話說明，供新案設計核對。

features.name: 宏信驗收紀錄
features.desc: 整合 283 項文字、392 張照片與對應驗收影片。

features.name: 媒體瀏覽器
features.desc: 照片與影片可在同一視窗用箭頭、縮圖及鍵盤切換。

features.name: 權限與廠區分流
features.desc: 登入後先選廠區，避免 KIIC 與宏信資料混算。

ai_usage: 以 AI 協助閱讀追加減報告，萃取項目、金額、原因與新手可理解的重點。
以 AI 協助將驗收文字分類、整理改善建議，並依使用者回饋調整網站文案與介面。

tools.name: React、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS
tools.desc: 建置繁體中文響應式前端與工地監造手帳風格。

tools.name: tRPC、Express、MySQL／Drizzle
tools.desc: 處理帳密登入、留言、資料查詢與跨執行個體工作階段。

tools.name: Manus S3 Storage
tools.desc: 提供驗收照片、影片、Logo 與模型檔案的網站資產儲存。

tools.name: Three.js
tools.desc: 預留廠區 STL、OBJ、GLB 模型瀏覽能力，目前前台暫時隱藏。

results: 完成 KIIC 七份追加減報告整合，總覽可查詢 68 個工程變更項目。
完成宏信驗收專區，支援分類、關鍵字、照片燈箱、影片縮圖與跨媒體切換。
建立帳密登入、廠區分流與管理員留言管理，正式站已上線使用。

value.name: 對業務單位
value.desc: 可快速取得建廠變更與驗收佐證，提升跨部門說明與追蹤效率。

value.name: 對客戶
value.desc: 可用結構化資料理解工程決策、缺失改善與現場佐證脈絡。

value.name: 對公司
value.desc: 累積跨國建廠知識，降低新案重複踩雷與資料散落風險。

extensions: 可複製至其他廠區，沿用廠區選擇、工程分類、驗收紀錄與媒體佐證結構。
可擴充改善進度、責任單位、結案日期、帳號管理及更多工程文件來源。
limitations: 金額、工程狀態與驗收結果須以核准報告及現場最新紀錄為準，網站需定期更新。
照片、影片與模型檔案應遵守公司資訊安全及授權規範，避免上傳不宜公開內容。
zh.success_key: 將原始工程佐證、白話說明與現場媒體放在同一查詢脈絡，並持續依使用者操作回饋調整資料結構與介面。

en.title: THC Group Plant Construction Project Database
en.summary: Integrates KIIC plant change orders, design optimization, and Hong Xin plant acceptance data, letting the team quickly search and track by plant, engineering category, amount, photos, and video.
en.unit_request: THC Group Plant Construction / Facilities Team
en.author: 馬崇耀
en.problem_background: Plant change-order reports, design reviews, acceptance records, and on-site photos were scattered across sources, making cross-plant data easy to mix up. New team members also had difficulty understanding the reasons behind engineering changes.
en.core_problem: How to preserve original supporting evidence while turning complex engineering data into a searchable, segmented, and understandable team knowledge base, while preventing non-logged-in users from browsing the content directly.
en.solution: Built a full-stack website with account/password protection that separates KIIC and Hong Xin data, organizing information via an engineering ledger, acceptance cards, a photo/video browser, and design guidelines.
process: Compiled seven KIIC change-order reports, design optimization conclusions, and Hong Xin acceptance records, photos, and videos.
Established a unified data structure organized by plant, engineering category, topic, amount, and report sequence.
Built site features including login, plant selection, search/filtering, media browsing, and comments.
Repeatedly validated on desktop, mobile, and the production site before launch, and continues to refine the interface based on field feedback.

features.name: KIIC Engineering Ledger
features.desc: Search change-order items and reasons by engineering category, amount, and report sequence.

features.name: Design Optimization Guidelines
features.desc: Contains 33 plant-construction lessons with plain-language explanations for reference in new projects.

features.name: Hong Xin Acceptance Records
features.desc: Integrates 283 text records, 392 photos, and corresponding acceptance videos.

features.name: Media Browser
features.desc: Photos and videos can be browsed in the same window using arrows, thumbnails, and keyboard navigation.

features.name: Access Control & Plant Segmentation
features.desc: Users select a plant after login to prevent KIIC and Hong Xin data from being mixed together.

ai_usage: Used AI to help read change-order reports and extract items, amounts, reasons, and beginner-friendly summaries.
Used AI to help categorize acceptance records, organize improvement suggestions, and refine site copy and UI based on user feedback.

tools.name: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
tools.desc: Built a responsive Traditional Chinese frontend with a construction-site field-notebook style.

tools.name: tRPC, Express, MySQL/Drizzle
tools.desc: Handles account/password login, comments, data queries, and cross-instance sessions.

tools.name: Manus S3 Storage
tools.desc: Provides asset storage for acceptance photos, videos, logos, and model files.

tools.name: Three.js
tools.desc: Reserved for browsing plant STL, OBJ, and GLB models; currently hidden on the frontend.

results: Completed integration of seven KIIC change-order reports; the overview covers 68 searchable engineering change items.
Completed the Hong Xin acceptance section, supporting categorization, keyword search, photo lightbox, video thumbnails, and cross-media switching.
Established account/password login, plant segmentation, and admin comment management; the production site is now live.

value.name: For Business Units
value.desc: Quickly access plant-construction changes and acceptance evidence, improving cross-department communication and tracking efficiency.

value.name: For Clients
value.desc: Structured data helps clients understand engineering decisions, defect remediation, and on-site supporting context.

value.name: For the Company
value.desc: Accumulates cross-border plant-construction knowledge, reducing repeated mistakes and scattered data in new projects.

extensions: Can be replicated for other plants, reusing the plant selection, engineering categorization, acceptance record, and media evidence structure.
Can be extended with improvement progress, responsible units, closure dates, account management, and additional engineering document sources.
limitations: Amounts, engineering status, and acceptance results must follow approved reports and the latest on-site records; the site requires regular updates.
Photos, videos, and model files must comply with company information security and licensing rules, avoiding inappropriate public content.
en.success_key: Keeps original engineering evidence, plain-language explanations, and on-site media within the same search context, and continuously refines the data structure and interface based on user feedback.

zh.title: AI 影片製作：鷹架使用安全說明
zh.summary: 以 AI 生成動畫與旁白配音，製作鷹架使用安全教育訓練影片，將原本需要真人演出、拍攝與剪輯的宣導影片，改為用 AI 工具產出卡通角色動畫搭配旁白說明，快速完成職安衛安全教材。
zh.unit_request: 無菌三廠 - 四線充填組
zh.unit_owner: 無菌三廠 - 四線充填組
zh.author: 紀裕慶（無菌三廠）
zh.problem_background: 鷹架使用安全規範（如人員、工具與材料總重量限制、架設與拆卸注意事項等）過去多以文字公告或真人拍攝影片宣導，製作真人影片需要協調人員演出、場地拍攝與後製剪輯，耗時且不易重複修改。
zh.core_problem: 如何以更快速、更低成本的方式，製作生動易懂的鷹架使用安全宣導影片，讓同仁容易理解並記住安全規範。
zh.solution: 改以 AI 生成動畫角色搭配旁白配音，將鷹架使用安全規範轉換為卡通動畫影片，用情境示範（如秤重限制、正確使用方式）取代真人演出，快速產出教育訓練與宣導用影片。
process: 整理鷹架使用安全規範重點與腳本內容
以 AI 工具生成動畫角色與場景畫面
以 AI 生成旁白語音並搭配字幕
完成影片剪輯與輸出

features.name: AI 動畫生成
features.desc: 以 AI 產生卡通角色與工廠場景動畫，取代真人拍攝

features.name: AI 旁白配音
features.desc: 以 AI 語音搭配動畫畫面，說明安全規範重點

features.name: 情境化演示
features.desc: 以動畫呈現重量限制、正確操作方式等安全情境，加深印象

ai_usage: 使用 AI 動畫生成技術製作角色與場景畫面
使用 AI 語音生成技術製作影片旁白

tools.name: AI 動畫生成工具
tools.desc: 產生卡通角色與工廠場景動畫畫面

tools.name: AI 語音生成工具
tools.desc: 產生影片旁白配音

results: 完成鷹架使用安全說明教育訓練影片
以動畫情境化方式呈現安全規範，較純文字公告更容易理解

value.name: 對無菌三廠
value.desc: 提升鷹架使用安全宣導的效率與教材品質，不需協調真人拍攝

value.name: 對公司
value.desc: 可複製此模式製作其他廠區職安衛教育訓練影片，降低影片製作成本

extensions: 各廠區其他職安衛教育訓練影片製作
各類作業安全規範宣導動畫
limitations: AI 生成的動畫內容與旁白仍需由職安衛專業人員確認規範內容正確性
zh.success_key: 以 AI 動畫與旁白取代真人拍攝，快速產出生動易懂的安全教育訓練影片。

en.title: AI Video Production: Scaffolding Safety Guidelines
en.summary: Used AI-generated animation and voiceover to produce a scaffolding safety training video, replacing live-action filming and editing with AI-generated cartoon character animation and narration to quickly complete occupational safety training materials.
en.author: Chi Yu-Ching (Aseptic Factory 3)
en.problem_background: Scaffolding safety rules (such as total weight limits for personnel, tools and materials, and setup/dismantling precautions) were previously communicated through text notices or live-action videos. Producing live-action videos required coordinating actors, on-site filming, and post-production editing, which was time-consuming and hard to revise.
en.core_problem: How to produce engaging, easy-to-understand scaffolding safety videos faster and at lower cost, so employees can better understand and remember the safety rules.
en.solution: Replaced live-action filming with AI-generated animated characters and voiceover, converting scaffolding safety rules into animated video with scenario demonstrations (such as weight limits and correct usage) to quickly produce training and awareness videos.
process: Organize key scaffolding safety rules and script content
Generate animated characters and scenes with AI tools
Generate voiceover narration with AI along with subtitles
Complete video editing and export

features.desc: Uses AI to generate cartoon characters and factory scene animation, replacing live-action filming

features.name: AI Voiceover
features.desc: Uses AI-generated voice paired with animation to explain key safety rules

features.name: Scenario-Based Demonstration
features.desc: Uses animation to depict weight limits and correct operating procedures, reinforcing memory

ai_usage: Uses AI animation generation technology to produce character and scene visuals
Uses AI voice generation technology to produce video narration

tools.name: AI Animation Generation Tool
tools.desc: Generates cartoon character and factory scene animation

tools.name: AI Voice Generation Tool
tools.desc: Generates video voiceover narration

results: Completed a scaffolding safety training video
Presents safety rules through animated scenarios, making them easier to understand than text-only notices

value.name: For Aseptic Factory 3
value.desc: Improves the efficiency and quality of scaffolding safety training materials without needing to coordinate live-action filming

value.name: For the Company
value.desc: This approach can be replicated to produce EHS training videos for other plants, reducing video production costs

extensions: EHS training videos for other plants
Animated awareness videos for other types of operational safety rules
limitations: AI-generated animation content and narration still need to be verified for accuracy by EHS professionals
en.success_key: Replaced live-action filming with AI animation and narration to quickly produce an engaging, easy-to-understand safety training video.

zh.title: Exploration 生命週期與歷程管理
zh.summary: 為探索案件建立暫停、恢復、完成與停止機制，保留原因、操作者與不可竄改的歷程，讓團隊能清楚追溯每次狀態變化。
zh.author: 吳承運
zh.status: 已完成測試版本，待建立 Git checkpoint
zh.region: 內部 Pilot 環境
zh.problem_background: 探索案件缺乏一致的生命週期與歷程紀錄，團隊難以辨識案件是暫停、完成或停止，也不易追溯決定原因。
zh.core_problem: 如何在不改變來源 Idea、不中斷既有 Critical Unknown 規則下，提供安全、可追溯且不可重開的 Exploration 狀態管理？
zh.solution: 新增 ACTIVE、PAUSED、COMPLETED、STOPPED 狀態；由建立者以原因完成合法轉換，並在同一交易中寫入不可變更事件。
process: 從共享 Idea 建立獨立 Exploration
建立者選擇可用狀態操作
填寫原因並送至伺服器驗證
原子更新狀態、時間與歷程事件
終態案件保留唯讀歷程，不可重開

features.name: 狀態轉換
features.desc: 支援暫停、恢復、完成與停止六種合法路徑

features.name: 原因紀錄
features.desc: 每次轉換必填原因，最長 2,000 字元

features.name: 歷程追溯
features.desc: 保存前後狀態、操作者、時間與原因

features.name: 終態保護
features.desc: 完成或停止後不可再次變更

features.name: 唯讀控制
features.desc: 非 ACTIVE 狀態不可修改 Critical Unknown

ai_usage: 本案例未使用 AI 自動判斷或自動轉換

en.title: Exploration Lifecycle & History Management
en.summary: Introduced pause, resume, complete, and stop mechanisms for exploration cases, preserving the reason, actor, and an immutable history so teams can clearly trace every state change.
en.author: Cheng-Yun Wu
en.status: Test version complete, pending Git checkpoint
en.problem_background: Exploration cases lacked a consistent lifecycle and history record, making it hard for teams to tell whether a case was paused, completed, or stopped, and difficult to trace the reasoning behind decisions.
en.core_problem: How to provide safe, traceable, non-reopenable Exploration state management without changing the source Idea or interrupting existing Critical Unknown rules?
en.solution: Added ACTIVE, PAUSED, COMPLETED, and STOPPED states. The creator completes legal transitions with a reason, and an immutable event is written in the same transaction.

Creator selects an available state action
Fill in a reason and submit for server-side validation
Atomically update the state, timestamp, and history event

zh.title: 集團不良品重量與廢料出售自動彙整系統
zh.summary: 將各廠不同格式的 Excel 廢料分析表一次上傳，自動辨識廠別、產品及合計數據，套入集團彙總範本並產生可下載報表，減少人工複製與核對時間。

zh.region: 集團各廠區，包含臺灣、大陸及東南亞

zh.core_problem: 如何在整批上傳時正確辨識每個廠別與產品，處理重複檔案、名稱差異及未編號廠區，並將數據寫入正確的原始彙總範本位置。

process: 一次選取各廠 Excel 報表並上傳。
系統辨識廠別、產品、合計列與重量欄位。
使用者檢查預覽及重複檔案警示。
確認後下載套用集團範本的彙總報表。
