en.title: THC LINE Insight: AI Analytics Platform for LINE Group Messages
en.summary: Plant and sales teams report equipment faults, production batches, QC checks, machine uptime and customer project progress in LINE groups every day, but these messages are buried in chat history and hard to search, count or follow up on afterwards. LINE Insight adds an official account to existing LINE groups, automatically receives every message, and uses AI to extract structured data according to the group type (fault events, production batches, project progress, open work issues, etc.), then presents KPIs, trends, rankings and timelines on a dashboard. Frontline staff keep reporting exactly as before, while managers move from scrolling through chats to reading a dashboard.
en.author: Hsu Chiao-Kuei
en.region: Group plants and business units (including Taiwan and overseas sites; supports Chinese, Thai, English and other languages)
en.problem_background: LINE groups are the most familiar and immediate communication tool for plant and sales teams: equipment faults, line production status, QC results, plant uptime and customer project progress are mostly reported directly in groups. But chat history is a running stream, and messages quickly scroll away. Answering questions like "How many times did this machine break down this month?", "Which projects are stuck waiting for a management decision?" or "Which unit hasn't reported today?" means manually scrolling back and compiling everything into Excel. Groups at overseas sites also mix in Thai and English, making them even harder to follow.
en.core_problem: How can unstructured conversations in LINE groups be automatically turned into searchable, measurable and trackable management information, without changing how frontline staff already report in LINE and without asking anyone to fill in extra forms?
en.solution:
A LINE official account is added to each unit's existing LINE groups and receives messages (text and images) in real time via webhook. AI extracts structured data according to the "analysis template" assigned to each group, stores it in a database and presents it on a dashboard. There are currently 7 analysis templates; a new group simply picks a suitable template and is ready to go, with no extra development:
- General (equipment fault analysis): extracts fault events and shows equipment fault rankings, failure Pareto charts and machine status
- Daily report (customer project progress): tracks customer project status, AI-flagged risks, items awaiting management decisions, manager instructions and key dates
- Production report (multi-unit uptime roll-up): consolidates plant uptime, reporting completion rates, and equipment and quality issues
- Line Mini-MES: reconstructs a timeline of production batches, CIP/SIP processes and fault events on a line
- Incident analysis: merges multiple progress updates about the same machine into a single incident tracked through to closure
- Line Mini-MES 2.0: parses formatted production batch reports, QC checks and machine shift reports
- Group work overview: tracks issues, open questions and schedule announcements in mixed-topic groups

Groups are organized by category (plant or department), and users only see the categories they are authorized for.
process: Add the LINE official account to existing work groups; the webhook receives group messages and images in real time
Admins assign each group a category and an analysis template in the back office, and enable options such as image analysis or multilingual translation as needed
AI extracts each message into structured data (events, batches, projects, issues, etc.) according to the template, keeping a link back to the original message
Low-confidence AI judgments go to a manual review queue for admins to confirm or correct
Users log in to the dashboard, filter by period and category to view KPIs, trend charts, rankings and timelines, and jump back to the original conversation in one click
The system pushes daily/weekly summaries to designated managers and backs up data automatically every day

Determines whether follow-up messages belong to an existing event or issue and merges them, re-evaluating status and priority from the full handling timeline
Automatically identifies project risks, items awaiting management decisions, and manager instructions

Generates daily/weekly highlight summaries and pushes them to managers
Claude Code served as the AI development partner throughout, enabling fast iteration on new templates and UI refinements

extensions: Any unit that reports work in LINE groups (plants, production lines, sales, QC, warehousing, etc.) can join directly and start by choosing a suitable template
New reporting formats can be supported by adding options to an existing template or creating a new analysis template
The structured data can be further connected to existing systems such as MES, ERP and maintenance systems

limitations: Only messages sent after the official account joins a group can be analyzed; earlier history must be imported separately

en.success_key: Don't change how people work: frontline staff keep reporting in LINE, and AI takes care of organizing the data. Combined with the "analysis template" design, different kinds of groups share one platform and the cost of onboarding a new unit is minimal — which is what allowed it to grow from a single group to multiple plants and departments.

zh.title: 工作待辦事項及會議通知 (LINE BOT)
zh.summary: 管理者可將交辦事項、樣品測試安排及會議通知（含時間與地點）登錄至系統，由 LINE BOT 於當天早上 08:00 自動推播至各課的 LINE 群組，提醒成員當日需要執行的工作事項。
zh.unit_request: 瓶品課（提出需求），後續展開至蓋品課及自貿課
zh.author: 謝欣錫
zh.region: 宏全一廠、宏全二廠
zh.problem_background: 過去交辦事項、樣品測試安排與會議通知多半靠主管口頭告知，同仁容易遺忘或漏掉；主管也必須每天自行查看行事曆，再逐一重複提醒各課成員，溝通成本高，也容易產生執行上的疏漏。
zh.core_problem: 工作事項缺乏統一、自動化的提醒機制，導致資訊傳遞仰賴人工且容易遺漏。
zh.solution: 管理者只需在 Excel 表格中填寫日期與事項內容，即可完成登錄與更新。系統每天由 AI 搭配 LINE BOT 比對表格資料，判斷當天是否有需要提醒的事項；若有，就在上午 08:00 自動推播至各課的 LINE 群組，不再需要人工逐一通知。
process: 管理者在雲端硬碟（n8n 專用資料夾）中的 Excel 填寫或更新日期、時間與待辦事項
n8n 每日定時觸發工作流程，讀取雲端 Excel 資料
AI 判斷當天是否有需要提醒的事項，並整理成通知訊息
若有，LINE BOT 在上午 08:00 將提醒推播至對應課別的 LINE 群組
同仁在群組中收到當日工作提醒並依此執行

en.title: Daily Task & Meeting Reminders (LINE BOT)
en.summary: Managers enter assigned tasks, sample test schedules and meeting notices (including time and location) into the system, and a LINE BOT automatically pushes them to each section's LINE group at 08:00 every morning, reminding members of the work they need to carry out that day.
en.unit_request: Bottle Quality Section (requester), later expanded to the Closure Quality Section and Free Trade Section
en.author: Hsieh Hsin-Hsi
en.region: Hon Chuan Plant 1, Hon Chuan Plant 2
en.problem_background: Assigned tasks, sample test schedules and meeting notices used to be communicated mostly by supervisors in person, so colleagues easily forgot or missed them. Supervisors also had to check their calendars every day and then remind each section's members one by one, which was costly in communication time and prone to execution gaps.
en.core_problem: There was no unified, automated reminder mechanism for work items, so information relied on manual relay and was easily missed.
en.solution: Managers only need to fill in the date and task details in an Excel sheet to register or update items. Every day, AI together with a LINE BOT checks the sheet to determine whether there are reminders due that day; if so, they are automatically pushed to each section's LINE group at 08:00, with no more manual notifications one by one.
process: Managers fill in or update dates, times and to-do items in an Excel file in the cloud drive (dedicated n8n folder)
n8n triggers the workflow on a daily schedule and reads the Excel data from the cloud
AI determines whether there are items to remind about that day and composes the notification message
If so, the LINE BOT pushes the reminder to the corresponding section's LINE group at 08:00
Colleagues receive the day's work reminder in the group and act on it

features.desc: Managers just fill in dates and details in a cloud Excel file — no new system to learn

features.name: Scheduled daily push
features.desc: Automatically sends the day's work reminders to each section's LINE group at 08:00 every morning

features.desc: Automatically picks out the day's items and formats them into an easy-to-read notice (date, time, item count)

features.name: No items, no noise
features.desc: Nothing is pushed on days with no to-dos, keeping groups free of unnecessary messages

features.name: Friday preview of next week
features.desc: Every Friday, compiles key work items for the following week so colleagues can prepare in advance

features.name: Multi-section notifications
features.desc: Pushes separately to different groups such as the Bottle, Closure and Free Trade sections

Gemini reads the Excel data to decide whether there are items to push for the day or the coming week
Gemini turns the sheet content into readable LINE notification messages and compiles the Friday preview of next week's key items

tools.desc: Stores the Excel file (dedicated n8n folder) so n8n can read it

results: Officially launched and rolled out to the Bottle, Closure and Free Trade quality sections across Hon Chuan Plant 1 and Plant 2
Automatically pushes about 15 work reminders per month on average
Supervisors no longer need to repeat reminders verbally every day, and missed or forgotten tasks have dropped noticeably
Every Friday, next week's key work is previewed automatically so colleagues can plan ahead

value.name: For supervisors
value.desc: No need to check the calendar and remind people one by one every day — enter it once in Excel and notifications go out automatically

value.name: For colleagues
value.desc: Receive the day's to-dos in LINE as soon as the workday starts, with clear work arrangements and fewer misses

value.name: For the company
value.desc: Lowers communication costs and the risk of human error, and establishes an automated notification model that can be replicated in other sections

extensions: Can be replicated to other sections or plants simply by adding an Excel sheet and the corresponding LINE group
Can be extended to reminders for recurring items such as equipment maintenance, calibration due dates and certificate renewals
A "done" reply feature could be added so supervisors can track execution status
Could be expanded to day-before previews or multiple reminders before a due date
limitations: Reminder content depends on what is entered in Excel; managers must update dates and items accurately and promptly
The Excel file must keep a fixed column format, otherwise AI judgment may be affected
The LINE BOT must be added to each section's group to push messages

The free LINE Official Account plan caps pushes at 200 messages per month, counted per recipient, so larger groups hit the cap faster; watch usage when expanding to more sections and switch to a paid plan if needed
The system depends on n8n, the cloud drive and Gemini working normally; an outage in any of them may mean no push that day
Pushed content is internal work information, so group membership must be controlled to prevent leaks
en.success_key: Using Excel, which colleagues already know, as the entry interface and LINE, which everyone uses daily, as the notification channel keeps the barrier low with nothing new to learn. n8n and Gemini then fully automate the checking and pushing, so supervisors only need to "enter it once" to replace daily repeated reminders — which is why it spread quickly.

zh.title: 集團產品搜尋平台（Group Product Finder）
zh.summary: 建立供集團內部使用的包裝產品搜尋與維護平台，讓業務人員可依產品分類、名稱、規格及產地快速查詢產品，查看產品詳細資訊與工廠供應關聯；授權維護者則可在同一平台更新產品與主檔資料。
zh.author: 吳承運
zh.status: 內網正式上線，持續優化中
zh.region: 集團內部（實際可用範圍依公司內網與帳號權限）
zh.problem_background: 產品資訊分散於不同型錄、表單與人員經驗中。業務在外拜訪客戶時，需要快速確認集團是否有相近產品、產品規格與可供應的工廠；產品資料異動也需要有明確的維護權限與紀錄。
zh.core_problem: 如何建立一個可快速搜尋、便於行動裝置瀏覽，且能區分「已確認供應工廠」與「具備生產能力工廠」的集團產品單一查詢入口，同時讓資料維護可控、可追溯。
zh.solution: 以集團產品主檔為核心，提供分類入口、關鍵字與規格篩選、產品詳細資訊，以及產品與工廠的兩種不同關聯。一般使用者可查詢產品；獲授權的維護者可更新產品、分類相關主檔及工廠關聯；管理員可管理維護者權限。平台以個人工號透過公司 LDAP 驗證登入，部署於公司內網。
process: 盤點並整理產品分類、產品規格、工廠主檔及既有產品資料。

en.title: Group Product Finder
en.summary: An internal group platform for searching and maintaining packaging products. Sales staff can quickly look up products by category, name, specification and origin, and view product details and plant supply relationships; authorized maintainers can update product and master data on the same platform.
en.author: Cheng-Yun Wu
en.status: Live on the intranet, under continuous improvement
en.region: Group internal (actual availability depends on the company intranet and account permissions)
en.problem_background: Product information was scattered across different catalogs, forms and people's experience. When visiting customers, sales staff need to quickly confirm whether the group has a similar product, its specifications and which plants can supply it; product data changes also need clear maintenance permissions and records.
en.core_problem: How to build a single group product lookup that is fast to search, easy to browse on mobile devices, and distinguishes "plants confirmed to supply" from "plants with production capability", while keeping data maintenance controlled and traceable.
en.solution: Built around the group product master data, the platform provides category entry points, keyword and specification filters, product details, and two distinct kinds of product–plant relationships. Regular users can search products; authorized maintainers can update products, category-related master data and plant relationships; admins manage maintainer permissions. Users sign in with their employee ID via the company LDAP, and the platform is deployed on the company intranet.
process: Inventory and organize product categories, product specifications, plant master data and existing product data.
Build product search, category browsing, product detail and maintenance interfaces.
Distinguish plants confirmed to supply from plants with production capability, with relationship maintenance and audit logs.
Deploy to the intranet after local testing, user acceptance and GitLab CI/CD checks.
Collect user feedback and keep refining the search experience, interface and data quality.

zh.title: 工作日誌彙整優化
zh.summary: 各產品早晚班同仁每天都需要將稽核資訊（例如機台編號、產品名稱及生產中遇到的突發狀況）彙整到 Excel 工作日誌中。過去要從紙本謄寫，導入無紙化後改從平板逐台謄寫，仍相當耗費人力。優化後只需輸入日期與稽核人員姓名，程式就會從 i-Reporter（IRP）系統抓取當天資料，自動匯出並填入工作日誌，大幅減少人工作業。
zh.author: 楊尚達、謝欣錫
zh.region: 宏全一廠、宏全二廠
zh.problem_background: 各產品的早晚班同仁每天都需要將稽核資訊（機台編號、料號、產品名稱、生產中遇到的突發狀況等）彙整到 Excel 工作日誌中。過去要從紙本謄寫到 Excel；導入無紙化後，雖然改在平板上記錄，但仍需逐台將平板上的資料謄寫到 Excel，不僅耗費大量人力與時間，也曾發生謄寫內容錯誤的情況。

en.title: Work Log Compilation Optimization
en.summary: Every day, morning- and night-shift staff for each product must compile audit information (such as machine IDs, product names and incidents during production) into an Excel work log. This used to be transcribed from paper, and after going paperless it was transcribed machine by machine from tablets, which still took a lot of manpower. Now staff only enter the date and the auditor's name, and the program pulls that day's data from the i-Reporter (IRP) system, exports it and fills in the work log automatically, greatly reducing manual work.
en.author: Yang Shang-Ta, Hsieh Hsin-Hsi
en.region: Hon Chuan Plant 1, Hon Chuan Plant 2
en.problem_background: Morning- and night-shift staff for each product must compile audit information (machine ID, part number, product name, incidents during production, etc.) into an Excel work log every day. It used to be transcribed from paper into Excel; after going paperless, records were kept on tablets, but the data still had to be transcribed into Excel machine by machine. This took a great deal of time and manpower, and transcription errors did occur.
en.core_problem: Even though audit data had been digitized, it still had to be manually transcribed into the work log machine by machine, which was labor-intensive and error-prone.
en.solution: An "i-Reporter Report Export Tool" was developed in Python, with customized versions for each product (for example, a label & film version). Staff only enter the report date and the auditor's name; the program automatically logs in to the i-Reporter (IRP) system, downloads that day's audit report as a CSV file, and writes it into the corresponding product's Excel work log, replacing manual machine-by-machine transcription.

Open the report export tool for the relevant product and enter the date and auditor's name
The program automatically logs in to i-Reporter (IRP) and downloads that day's audit report as a CSV file
The program automatically writes the report data into that product's Excel work log
Staff review the work log, and supervisors add their comments in the log

en.title: Automated Domestic COA Creation
en.summary: Domestic shipments must include a Certificate of Analysis (COA). Previously, warehouse shipping information was handwritten on a shipping sheet and then manually keyed into the EIP system to produce the COA. Now staff enter the shipping information into the shipping sheet and an automation program generates the COA directly, eliminating duplicate data entry and improving the efficiency and accuracy of shipping documents.
en.author: Hsieh Hsin-Hsi, Yang Shang-Ta, Huang Sheng-Kai, Liu Chi-Wei
en.region: Hon Chuan Plant 1, Hon Chuan Plant 2
en.problem_background: Domestic shipments must include a Certificate of Analysis (COA). The old process was to photograph the shipping information at the warehouse, handwrite it on a shipping sheet, and finally key it manually, entry by entry, into the EIP system to generate the COA. Each product took about 45 minutes of data entry per day on average, and typos occurred in the date, quantity and remarks fields. During the peak production season, with high shipping volumes, entry and checking took even longer and the workload grew noticeably.
en.core_problem: COAs could only be produced through handwriting and repeated manual data entry, which was time-consuming, error-prone, and hard to scale for high peak-season shipping volumes.
en.solution: After staff enter warehouse shipping information into an Excel shipping sheet, a Python automation program reads the product name, manufacturing date and quantity, and—based on the inspection data recorded in the IRP system's daily audits—automatically logs in to the EIP system to generate the COA (PDF), replacing the handwritten and manual entry process.
process: Photograph shipping information at the warehouse
Enter shipping information (manufacturing date, quantity) into the Excel shipping sheet
Run the Python automation program to read the shipping sheet
The program matches the corresponding daily audit inspection data in the IRP system
The program automatically creates the COA in the EIP system and generates a PDF
Staff review the COA content

zh.title: 外銷COA 自動建立
zh.summary: 外銷出貨需依不同客戶與國家的要求（例如香港太古、BPKS 等），提供特定格式與檢驗項目的英文版檢驗報告書（COA），並配合客戶需求呈現訂單相關資料。本案例透過自動化程式擷取測試數據與訂單資訊，依各客戶範本自動產出 Word 或 Excel 格式的 COA，確認後再轉為 PDF，取代人工逐份製作。
zh.author: 謝欣錫、楊尚達、黃聖凱、劉騏維
zh.status: 部分上線（尚有 2 種產品開發中，預計 2026 年 10 月底前完成）
zh.region: 宏全一廠、宏全二廠
zh.problem_background: 外銷出貨需依不同客戶與國家的要求，提供特定格式與檢驗項目的英文版 COA。過去的作業方式是先到現場取得 Bar Code 資訊，再手動輸入 PO 碼、製造日期與箱號對應、檢驗數據匯出等出貨資訊；部分客戶（例如港可 SCCK）還需另外手動登打出貨明細。由於資訊項目眾多，每份 COA 至少需花費 30 分鐘製作，輸入時也經常發生箱號、流水號等錯誤。
zh.core_problem: 外銷 COA 格式依客戶而異且資訊繁多，人工逐份登打耗時，箱號、流水號等錯誤頻繁發生。
zh.solution: 以 Python 開發自動化程式，將現場取得的 Bar Code、PO 碼、箱號等出貨資訊一律由程式直接載入，避免人工輸入錯誤。檢驗數據一部分自動從 IRP 系統取得，另需額外量測的項目則整理成 Excel 檔後由程式載入。每位客戶各有一份專屬範本，程式依產品料號從範本資料夾抓取對應的範本與檢驗項目，自動產出 Word 或 Excel 格式的英文版 COA，經確認無誤後再轉為 PDF。

en.title: Automated Export COA Creation
en.summary: Export shipments require English Certificates of Analysis (COAs) in specific formats and with specific test items depending on the customer and country (e.g. Swire Hong Kong, BPKS), presenting order-related data as each customer requires. This case uses an automation program to extract test data and order information and automatically produce COAs in Word or Excel format from each customer's template, which are converted to PDF after review—replacing manual, document-by-document preparation.
en.author: Hsieh Hsin-Hsi, Yang Shang-Ta, Huang Sheng-Kai, Liu Chi-Wei
en.status: Partially launched (2 products still in development, expected by end of October 2026)
en.region: Hon Chuan Plant 1, Hon Chuan Plant 2
en.problem_background: Export shipments require English COAs in specific formats and with specific test items depending on the customer and country. Previously, staff first collected barcode information on site, then manually entered shipping information such as PO numbers, manufacturing dates mapped to carton numbers, and exported inspection data; some customers (e.g. SCCK) also required shipping details to be keyed in separately. With so many data items, each COA took at least 30 minutes to prepare, and errors in carton and serial numbers were common.
en.core_problem: Export COA formats vary by customer and contain a lot of information; manual preparation of each document was time-consuming, and errors in carton and serial numbers occurred frequently.
en.solution: A Python automation program loads all shipping information collected on site—barcodes, PO numbers, carton numbers and more—directly, avoiding manual entry errors. Part of the inspection data is pulled automatically from the IRP system, while additionally measured items are compiled into an Excel file for the program to load. Each customer has its own template; the program uses the product part number to pick the matching template and test items from the template folder, automatically produces the English COA in Word or Excel format, and converts it to PDF once reviewed.
process: Collect barcode and other shipping information on site
Shipping information (PO number, manufacturing date, carton number, serial number, etc.) is loaded directly by the program from TXT or Excel files
The program retrieves inspection data from the IRP system
Additionally measured items are compiled into an Excel file and loaded by the program
The program picks the matching customer template from the template folder by product part number
An English COA is generated automatically in Word or Excel format
Staff review the COA and convert it to a PDF file

zh.title: AI 輔助建廠專案資料庫與工程總帳系統開發
zh.summary: 以建廠專案的實際管理流程為核心，整合廠區資料、啟動查核表、會議紀錄、設計準則與工程總帳。專案團隊透過自然語言需求和畫面回饋持續調整介面與功能，讓規格、照片、文件、發包資料及設計變更可在同一套系統中查閱與維護。
zh.author: 馬崇耀
zh.status: 本機版本運行中，持續迭代
zh.region: 跨國建廠專案；目前以印尼 KIIC 廠區資料為主要案例
zh.problem_background: 建廠初期的土地、法規、產能、設備、能源、辦公與人力條件，以及後續的會議、發包和設計變更資料，分散在不同文件與紀錄中。隨著廠區和附件增加，資料查找、版本追蹤與跨工程彙整會變得困難。
zh.core_problem: 如何讓不同廠區及工程類別的資料集中保存、方便更新與查詢，並使工程金額摘要能隨原始發包資料及設計變更卡片同步變動。
zh.solution: 建立依廠區組織的網頁系統。每個廠區包含建廠查核表、需求規格、會議紀錄、資料管理與工程總帳；土建、機電、室修工程分別管理發包資料、工程時程、設計變更報告及追加追減卡片。金額摘要從有效卡片重新加總，照片與文件可留存並在頁內預覽。
process: 蒐集使用者以文字和畫面截圖提出的需求，確認各頁面欄位與操作流程。
逐步建立廠區、規格、會議紀錄及工程總帳功能，保留既有資料的可編輯性。
依實際使用回饋調整排版、附件預覽、圖片標註與上傳流程。
以型別檢查、回歸測試及本機部署檢查驗證修改，再持續修正問題。

en.title: AI-Assisted Plant Construction Project Database & Engineering Ledger System
en.summary: Built around the real management workflow of plant construction projects, this system brings together site data, kickoff checklists, meeting minutes, design guidelines and the engineering ledger. The project team keeps refining the interface and features through natural-language requests and screenshot feedback, so specifications, photos, documents, contract award data and design changes can all be viewed and maintained in one system.
en.author: 馬崇耀
en.region: Cross-border plant construction projects; currently centered on the Indonesia KIIC plant
en.problem_background: Early-stage plant construction conditions — land, regulations, capacity, equipment, energy, office and manpower — along with later meeting, contract award and design change records, were scattered across different documents and logs. As the number of sites and attachments grew, finding data, tracking versions and consolidating across engineering disciplines became difficult.
en.core_problem: How to keep data for different sites and engineering categories in one place, easy to update and search, with engineering cost summaries that update automatically from the original contract award data and design change cards.
en.solution: A web system organized by site. Each site includes a construction checklist, requirement specifications, meeting minutes, data management and an engineering ledger; civil, mechanical & electrical (M&E) and interior works each manage their own contract award data, schedules, design change reports and addition/deduction cards. Cost summaries are recalculated from active cards, and photos and documents are stored and previewable in-page.
process: Collect requirements that users submit as text and screenshots, and confirm the fields and workflow for each page.
Incrementally build site, specification, meeting minutes and engineering ledger features while keeping existing data editable.
Adjust layout, attachment preview, image annotation and the upload flow based on real usage feedback.
Verify changes with type checking, regression tests and local deployment checks, then keep fixing issues.

features.desc: Manage civil, M&E and interior works separately, and total the original contract, additions and deductions.

features.desc: Store amounts, content, dates, photos and documents; deleting or restoring a card updates the totals.

features.desc: Upload and browse site photos, videos and engineering attachments in-page.

features.desc: Show the currency of each site's country and convert amounts using configured exchange rates.

ai_usage: Turn users' natural-language requests and screenshot feedback into changes to pages, data fields and interactions.
Help troubleshoot upload limits, save errors and page crashes, and add the corresponding validation and regression tests.

tools.desc: Build the editable web interface.

results: A locally running plant construction project database that integrates many types of requirement specifications and engineering records.
The engineering ledger updates cost summaries from active contract award and design change cards, with category-based search.
Photos, videos and documents are kept in one place; many operations support edit, delete and restore.

zh.author: 林玟臻

逾期處理｜系統通知承辦職護及相關員工，依設定持續提醒並記錄處理情形。
結案留存｜依評估結果完成追蹤，保存簽核、分級變更及歷史紀錄。

en.title: Health Management System
en.summary: Brings together employee health checkups, occupational health nurse workflows and physician sign-off into one digital process—from record creation and health classification to follow-up and case closure—so the company can see pending and overdue cases and keep a complete health history.
en.unit_request: Occupational Health Nursing / Human Resources (exact unit to be confirmed)
en.author: 林玟臻
en.status: Case planning; actual build and launch status to be confirmed
en.region: Plants and office sites across the company (actual scope to be confirmed)
en.problem_background: Pre-employment physical data, general and special health checkup reports, health documents and follow-up records were scattered across paper, spreadsheets and email. Nurses had to compile them one by one and chase physician sign-off, making it hard to see each employee's health classification and follow-up progress in real time.
en.core_problem: There was no unified index for the data, and sign-off and follow-up relied on manual handoffs. Multi-year health histories were hard to look up, and cases awaiting documents, awaiting sign-off or overdue for follow-up were easily missed.
en.solution: Build an employee-centric health data and case management platform that links employee self-reporting, nurse review, physician sign-off and follow-up notifications. Health classifications are managed based on professional assessment, and role-based permissions protect personal health data.
process: Onboarding records | Import employee master data, record pre-employment physical data and upload related documents.
Data consolidation | Collect general/special checkup data and employee-reported blood pressure and blood sugar; nurses verify completeness and measurement source.
Professional assessment | Nurses list items needing attention and send them for physician review and sign-off; the health classification and follow-up advice are recorded.
Follow-up | Nurses create follow-up items with owners and deadlines; progress is updated as employees submit documents or report back.
Overdue handling | The system notifies the responsible nurse and employee, keeps reminding per settings and logs how each case was handled.
Closure and retention | Follow-up is completed per the assessment, and sign-offs, classification changes and history are retained.

zh.author: 陳芝妮
zh.status: 教育訓練教材及動畫完成
zh.region: 公司飲料製造廠區
zh.problem_background:
飲料工廠具有生產設備、輸送帶、馬達、包裝設備、堆高機及其他多種噪音來源。

傳統噪音教育訓練多以文字、法規及靜態簡報呈現，受訓人員較難將抽象的噪音形成、暴露及防護觀念與自己的實際工作環境連結。
zh.core_problem: 如何在維持職業安全衛生專業正確性的前提下，將抽象的噪音知識轉化成員工看得懂、容易理解，而且與飲料工廠實際作業相關的教育內容。
zh.solution: 由職安人員主導專業內容，再利用生成式 AI 建立飲料工廠Q版人物、設備及作業情境，並將噪音形成、噪音來源、預防、工程改善、個人防護及健康管理等內容製作成簡報及動畫教材。

en.title: Generative AI-Assisted Noise Hazard Prevention Training for Beverage Plants
en.summary:
For the noisy working environment of beverage manufacturing plants, generative AI was used to help plan the course structure, organize training content, create chibi-style scene illustrations, write animation scripts and storyboards, produce videos and assemble the final materials.

Professional content on how noise forms, on-site noise sources, engineering controls, personal protection and health management was turned into scenario-based training materials that closely reflect the real working environment of a beverage plant.
en.author: 陳芝妮
en.problem_background:
Beverage plants have many noise sources, including production equipment, conveyors, motors, packaging machines and forklifts.

Traditional noise training relies mostly on text, regulations and static slides, making it hard for trainees to connect abstract ideas about how noise forms, exposure and protection with their own workplace.
en.core_problem: How to turn abstract noise knowledge into training content that employees can easily understand and relate to their actual beverage-plant work, while keeping occupational safety and health content professionally accurate.
en.solution: Safety staff lead the professional content, while generative AI is used to create chibi-style beverage-plant characters, equipment and work scenes. Noise formation, noise sources, prevention, engineering controls, personal protection and health management are then turned into slides and animated training materials.
process: Survey noise-related work in beverage plants and the training needs
Build the course structure and key teaching points for each unit
Use generative AI to help organize content and teaching logic
Create chibi-style beverage-plant characters, equipment and scenes
Design animation scripts, storyboards and generation prompts
Produce scenario videos on noise formation, prevention, protection and follow-up
Post-produce narration, ambient sound and Traditional Chinese subtitles
Integrate everything into the official training slide deck
Check every page for correct safety content, characters, equipment and scenarios

zh.title: AI 堆高機追蹤安全研發
zh.summary: 利用既有監視器影像結合AI影像辨識技術，研究人員行走辨識、人員追蹤及安全帽判定的可行性，希望使傳統監視器由「事後錄影回看」逐步發展為可協助辨識作業風險的智慧職安工具。
zh.unit_request: 職業安全衛生及廠區作業管理相關單位
zh.unit_owner: 職安衛中心／相關技術協作單位
zh.author: 陳芝妮

zh.region: 工廠、倉儲及物流作業區
zh.problem_background:

因此嘗試利用AI影像辨識，探索監視器主動協助安全管理的可能性。
zh.core_problem: 如何利用既有監視器影像辨識人員、追蹤人員活動，並進一步研究堆高機駕駛及安全行為辨識的可行性。
zh.solution: 以實際監視器畫面進行測試，逐步建立人員辨識、人員追蹤及堆高機相關安全辨識功能，並記錄成功與失敗測試結果，作為後續模型及資料調整依據。

en.title: AI Forklift Tracking Safety R&D
en.summary: Using existing CCTV footage with AI image recognition, this project studies the feasibility of detecting walking personnel, tracking people and judging hard-hat use—aiming to evolve traditional cameras from "recording for later review" into smart safety tools that help identify operational risks.
en.unit_request: Occupational safety & health and site operations management units
en.unit_owner: Occupational Safety & Health Center / related technical partners
en.author: 陳芝妮
en.status: In R&D | Current stage: walking-person detection, hard-hat judgment and image recognition testing
en.problem_background:
CCTV is mainly used for playback after the fact, so safety staff still have to watch large amounts of footage manually to check whether forklift operations meet safety requirements.

The project therefore explores using AI image recognition so cameras can actively support safety management.
en.core_problem: How to use existing CCTV footage to detect and track people, and further study the feasibility of recognizing forklift drivers and their safety behavior.
en.solution: Test with real CCTV footage, gradually building person detection, person tracking and forklift-related safety recognition, while recording both successful and failed tests as the basis for later model and data adjustments.

Collect real CCTV footage of operations
Test person detection

Test forklift safety recognition
Analyze why recognition succeeded or failed
Adjust data volume, resolution and model settings
Plan follow-up violation event logging and reporting

zh.title: 生成式 AI 輔助危險能量控制、上鎖掛牌與感電危害預防教育訓練
zh.summary:
針對設備維修、異常排除及電氣作業可能發生的危險能量與感電事故，將公司危險能量管制程序、能源隔離觀念及相關安全要求，結合生成式AI製作成情境式教育訓練教材。

核心觀念為：設備停止運轉，不代表危險能量已經隔離。

教材內容包含危險能量辨識、能源隔離、上鎖掛牌、殘留能量釋放、零能量驗證及感電危害預防。
zh.unit_request: 生產、品保、倉儲、維修及相關作業單位
zh.author: 陳芝妮
zh.status: 正式教育訓練教材完成
zh.region: 公司工廠及設備作業區
zh.problem_background:
設備按下停止按鈕後，仍可能存在電、氣、壓力、熱、重力、轉動慣性或其他殘留能量。

若將「設備停止」誤認為「設備已安全」，在維修、清潔、卡料排除或異常處理時，仍可能發生夾傷、捲入、燙傷、噴濺或感電等危害。
zh.core_problem: 如何讓不同工作角色理解：停機 ≠ 危險能量已隔離，並知道一般員工、作業人員及電氣專業人員各自可以做到哪一步。
zh.solution: 將危險能量控制及感電預防轉換成工廠情境式教材，說明從危險辨識、停機、能源隔離、上鎖掛牌、釋能、驗證到安全復歸的完整邏輯。
process: 盤點公司危險能量管制程序
整理危險能量種類
建立現場作業情境
區分不同工作角色的作業界線
建立危險能量與感電教育架構
製作情境式教材及影片
加入感電及電氣安全內容
建立互動判斷題

en.title: Generative AI-Assisted Training on Hazardous Energy Control, Lockout/Tagout and Electrical Hazard Prevention
en.summary:
To address hazardous energy and electric shock incidents that can occur during equipment maintenance, troubleshooting and electrical work, the company's hazardous energy control procedure, energy isolation concepts and related safety requirements were combined with generative AI to create scenario-based training materials.

The core message: stopping a machine does not mean its hazardous energy has been isolated.

The materials cover hazardous energy identification, energy isolation, lockout/tagout, releasing stored energy, zero-energy verification and electrical hazard prevention.
en.unit_request: Production, QA, warehousing, maintenance and related operating units
en.author: 陳芝妮
en.region: Company plants and equipment operating areas
en.problem_background:
After the stop button is pressed, equipment may still hold electrical, pneumatic, pressure, thermal, gravitational, rotational-inertia or other stored energy.

If "equipment stopped" is mistaken for "equipment safe," maintenance, cleaning, jam clearing or troubleshooting can still lead to pinching, entanglement, burns, spray or electric shock.
en.core_problem: How to help people in different roles understand that stopping ≠ isolating hazardous energy, and know how far general employees, operators and qualified electrical staff are each allowed to go.
en.solution: Turn hazardous energy control and electrical hazard prevention into plant-based scenario training that explains the full sequence: hazard identification, shutdown, energy isolation, lockout/tagout, energy release, verification and safe restart.
process: Review the company's hazardous energy control procedure
Organize the types of hazardous energy
Build on-site work scenarios
Define work boundaries for different roles
Build the hazardous energy and electrical safety course structure
Create scenario-based materials and videos
Add electric shock and electrical safety content
Create interactive judgment questions
Integrate company procedures, materials and lecture content
Deliver the official training

zh.author: 林玟臻
zh.status: 案例規劃；實際建置與上線狀態待確認
zh.region: 企業內部各廠區（實際適用範圍待確認）
zh.problem_background: 環保許可證照、申請附件及核定文件分散保存，期限與展延作業依賴人工提醒；變更案件、環境檢測報告與廢棄物合約書分屬不同管理流程，主管不易掌握完整辦理狀態。
zh.core_problem: 證照版本與適用範圍不易確認，展延待辦缺乏一致的期限管理，變更案件的文件、負責人與進度缺少集中追蹤。
zh.solution: 建立以廠區與許可證為主軸的管理平台，集中保存證照、期限及版本，將展延與變更作業轉為案件流程，提供主管 Dashboard，並以共同識別碼串接相關檢測及合約文件。
process: 基礎建檔｜盤點各廠區證照，登錄許可類別、證號、效期、適用範圍及承辦人。
文件歸檔｜上傳證照、申請附件與核定文件，建立版本及關聯。
期限提醒｜依證照效期與承辦設定建立提醒節點，指派展延待辦。
展延辦理｜追蹤資料準備、內部審核、送件、補件與核定進度。
變更管理｜記錄變更原因、影響範圍與相關文件，經審核後更新許可資料及版本。
資料串接｜關聯環境檢測報告及廢棄物合約書，供案件查閱與附件準備。
主管檢視｜以 Dashboard 查看即將到期、逾期、展延及變更案件，核定後歸檔留存。

en.title: Environmental Permit Management System
en.summary: Centrally manages environmental permits and documents, brings together expiry dates, renewals and change cases, gives managers a Dashboard to track progress, and is planned to link with environmental monitoring and waste contract management data.
en.unit_request: Environmental management unit and plant-level permit handlers (exact unit to be confirmed)
en.author: 林玟臻
en.status: Case planning; actual build and launch status to be confirmed
en.region: Company plants (actual scope to be confirmed)
en.problem_background: Environmental permits, application attachments and approval documents were stored in different places, and expiry and renewal relied on manual reminders. Change cases, environmental monitoring reports and waste contracts each followed separate processes, making it hard for managers to see the full picture.
en.core_problem: It was hard to confirm permit versions and scope, renewal to-dos lacked consistent deadline management, and documents, owners and progress for change cases were not tracked in one place.
en.solution: Build a management platform organized by plant and permit that centrally stores permits, expiry dates and versions, turns renewals and changes into case workflows, provides a manager Dashboard, and links related monitoring and contract documents through shared identifiers.
process: Master data | Inventory each plant's permits and record permit type, number, validity, scope and handler.
Document filing | Upload permits, application attachments and approval documents, with versions and links.
Deadline reminders | Set reminder points based on permit validity and handler settings, and assign renewal to-dos.
Renewal handling | Track data preparation, internal review, submission, supplements and approval.
Change management | Record the reason, impact and related documents for each change, then update permit data and version after review.
Data linking | Link environmental monitoring reports and waste contracts for case lookup and attachment preparation.
Manager review | Use the Dashboard to see expiring, overdue, renewal and change cases, and archive after approval.

features.desc: Search documents, validity and versions by plant, permit type and number.

features.name: Expiry and renewal reminders
features.desc: Set reminder points, handlers and due dates, keeping notification and handling records.

en.title: Generative AI-Assisted CPR/AED Emergency Response Training
en.summary:
Using generative AI, animation generation and AI voice technology, the CPR and AED emergency response procedure was turned into chibi-style 3D animations set in the company's own plants.

The full rescue sequence is shown as one continuous scenario: finding the casualty, checking responsiveness, calling for help, chest compressions, using the AED and handing over to 119 paramedics.
en.unit_request: Employee training and emergency response units
en.author: 陳芝妮
en.problem_background: CPR and AED training involves continuous actions, timing, role division and teamwork. Text or static images alone struggle to show the full rescue process as it happens in a real emergency.
en.core_problem: How to turn the full first-aid procedure into plant-based animations that employees can easily watch, understand and remember, while keeping the key CPR/AED actions correct.
en.solution: Use generative AI to create fixed chibi-style 3D characters and plant scenes, break the full first-aid procedure into multiple animated shots, and control each scene's character actions, positions, CPR technique, AED use and 119 handover—then finish with narration, subtitles and video integration.

Create fixed chibi-style 3D characters and the plant environment
Design character actions, positions and camera angles for each scene
Generate animations with AI
Correct the chest compression technique
Correct AED operation and pad placement
Build the 119 paramedic handover sequence
Produce AI narration
Add Traditional Chinese subtitles in post-production
Assemble the complete training video

zh.title: 運用 AI 製作環安衛與心理諮詢宣導資料
zh.summary: 以飲料製造廠的生產、倉儲與輪班工作情境為基礎，運用 AI 協助撰寫職安、環保、職護／健康促進及心理諮詢／員工協助方案（EAP）宣導文案，製作圖卡、海報與多語素材。透過專業審核、版本管理與分眾發布，讓員工快速掌握工作注意事項與求助管道。本案例為應用規劃，實際導入與成效待驗證。
zh.unit_request: 建議由環安衛、職護與人資單位共同提出需求。
zh.author: 林玟臻
zh.status: 應用規劃（導入狀態待確認）
zh.region: 飲料製造廠及其倉儲、辦公區；依各廠所在地規範與員工語言需求調整。
zh.problem_background: 飲料製造廠涉及產線設備、叉車搬運、清洗作業、化學品使用及輪班工作，宣導須兼顧職業安全、環境管理、身心健康與不同語言員工的理解需求。傳統文案與設計需多次協調，內容更新、跨廠沿用與發布品質不易一致。
zh.core_problem: 如何縮短宣導素材製作時間，同時確保內容正確、易讀、符合現場作業情境，並讓心理諮詢與 EAP 資源容易取得且維護員工隱私。
zh.solution: 建立「核准資料輸入—AI 草稿與視覺製作—專業審核—定稿發布—回饋更新」流程。將同一主題轉為班前會短文、圖卡、海報與多語版本；心理資源 QR Code 僅連至公司確認的有效管道，經測試後發布。
process: 蒐集需求｜確認受眾、宣導主題、發布位置與語言，選用現行作業規範、核准教材及正式 EAP 資訊。
製作草稿｜AI 將資料整理為標題、重點與行動提醒，產出海報版面構想及圖像初稿。
專業審核｜環安衛確認職安與環保內容，職護確認健康訊息，人資及 EAP 窗口確認服務範圍、保密說明與求助資訊；多語內容由合格人員複核。
定稿檢查｜確認圖文一致、字級與對比清楚、無錯誤作業示範，並測試 QR Code 的目的頁、權限與手機操作。
核准發布｜依公司流程核准，標示版本、日期與維護窗口，發布至公告欄、休息區、班前會及公司內部管道。
回饋更新｜蒐集匿名理解度與實用性回饋；制度、作業或資源異動時同步更新，撤下過期素材。

extensions: 建立主題素材庫與固定提示詞，延伸至新人訓練、承攬商入廠宣導及年度健康活動。
各廠沿用共通版型，替換現場照片、作業規範、語言與正式服務資訊，經當地權責單位重新審核。
limitations: AI 內容須經專業人員審核，不取代現場教育訓練、風險評估、醫療判斷或心理諮詢服務。
僅使用經核准且適合輸入工具的資料；不得輸入個人健康紀錄、諮詢內容、可識別員工資訊或未授權機密。
EAP 宣導須如實說明服務資格、保密範圍與例外；緊急求助資訊由權責單位核定，不宣稱一般預約管道能即時處理危機。
QR Code 不連至虛構或未驗證資源；如蒐集使用數據，採匿名彙總，不追蹤個別員工的心理資源使用行為。
圖像不得呈現錯誤操作或不適當防護；確認素材授權、多語翻譯與所在地規範，過期版本應撤下。
zh.success_key: 以核准資料為基礎，明確分工並保留人工審核，讓每份素材只傳達少量、可執行的重點。將正式資源、版本維護及員工匿名回饋納入流程，才能持續提升宣導品質與信任。

en.title: Using AI to Create EHS and Counseling Awareness Materials
en.summary: Based on the production, warehousing and shift-work realities of beverage plants, AI helps write awareness copy on occupational safety, environmental protection, occupational health/health promotion and counseling/Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and produce info cards, posters and multilingual materials. With professional review, version control and audience-specific distribution, employees can quickly grasp work reminders and where to get help. This case is an application plan; actual rollout and results are to be verified.
en.unit_request: Suggested as a joint request from the EHS, occupational health nursing and HR units.
en.author: 林玟臻
en.status: Application planning (rollout status to be confirmed)
en.region: Beverage plants and their warehouses and offices; adjusted for each site's local regulations and employees' language needs.
en.problem_background: Beverage plants involve production equipment, forklift handling, cleaning work, chemical use and shift work. Awareness materials must cover occupational safety, environmental management and physical and mental health, and be understood by employees who speak different languages. Traditional copywriting and design take many rounds of coordination, and it is hard to keep content updates, cross-plant reuse and publishing quality consistent.
en.core_problem: How to shorten the time needed to produce awareness materials while keeping content accurate, readable and relevant to on-site work—and make counseling and EAP resources easy to reach while protecting employee privacy.
en.solution: Set up a workflow of "approved source input → AI draft and visuals → professional review → final release → feedback and updates." One topic is turned into a pre-shift briefing note, info card, poster and multilingual versions; counseling QR codes link only to channels confirmed by the company and are tested before release.
process: Gather needs | Confirm audience, topic, placement and language, using current work rules, approved training materials and official EAP information.
Draft | AI organizes the material into headlines, key points and action reminders, and produces poster layout ideas and draft images.

Professional review | EHS checks safety and environmental content, nurses check health messages, HR and the EAP contact confirm service scope, confidentiality and help information; multilingual content is checked by qualified reviewers.
Final check | Confirm text and images match, font sizes and contrast are clear, no unsafe practices are shown, and test each QR code's destination, access and mobile use.
Approve and release | Approve per company process, label version, date and maintainer, and post to notice boards, break areas, pre-shift meetings and internal channels.
Feedback and updates | Collect anonymous feedback on clarity and usefulness; update when policies, work methods or resources change, and remove outdated materials.

features.name: Safety awareness
features.desc: Scenario reminders on machine guarding, handling routes, wet floors and chemical work, based on approved rules.

features.name: Environmental awareness
features.desc: Info cards on waste sorting, saving water and energy, and reporting abnormalities, matching plant procedures.

features.name: Occupational health & health promotion
features.desc: Information on shift-work health, recognizing fatigue, musculoskeletal health and health activities.

features.name: Counseling & EAP
features.desc: Friendly, de-stigmatizing copy introducing services, how to book and confidentiality scope, with verified counseling resource QR codes.

features.name: Multilingual & multi-format
features.desc: Multilingual versions as needed, turned into posters, cards and pre-shift notes with a consistent core message.

ai_usage: Copywriting | Summarize, rewrite and condense approved material into versions for different audiences, plus review checklists.
Visuals | Generate draft illustrations and layout ideas; people correct equipment, PPE and site details, then add official text with layout tools.
Translation support | Produce multilingual drafts and term glossaries, used only after people check safety instructions and service descriptions.
Update support | Compare old and new approved sources and list copy and materials that need changes, for owners to confirm.

tools.name: Company-approved generative AI writing tool
tools.desc: Summaries, rewrites, draft translations and version comparison; actual tool to be selected.

tools.name: Company-approved AI image and layout tools
tools.desc: Draft illustrations, cards and posters, with text and details corrected by people.

tools.name: QR code tool
tools.desc: Turns company-confirmed official counseling resource URLs into QR codes, tested before release.

tools.name: Internal document and publishing platform
tools.desc: Stores approved sources, review records and versions, and publishes materials per company permissions.

value.name: For EHS and nursing units
value.desc: Expected to reduce repeated writing and layout time and improve content updates and cross-department collaboration.

value.name: For employees
value.desc: Expected to make materials easier to read and more accessible in multiple languages, helping people understand work reminders and find mental health support.

value.name: For the company
value.desc: Expected to create a traceable, reusable awareness workflow; after rollout, results will be verified by production hours, review revisions, comprehension and anonymous overall feedback.

extensions: Build a topic asset library and standard prompts, extending to new-hire training, contractor site induction and annual health activities.
Plants reuse shared templates, swapping in site photos, work rules, languages and official service information, re-reviewed by local owners.
limitations: AI content must be reviewed by professionals and does not replace on-site training, risk assessment, medical judgment or counseling services.
Only approved data suitable for the tool may be entered; never personal health records, counseling content, identifiable employee information or unauthorized confidential data.

EAP materials must accurately state eligibility, confidentiality scope and exceptions; emergency help information is set by the responsible unit, and general booking channels must not be presented as handling crises in real time.
QR codes must not link to fictional or unverified resources; any usage data is collected anonymously in aggregate, without tracking individual employees' use of counseling resources.
Images must not show unsafe practices or inappropriate protection; confirm image rights, translations and local regulations, and remove outdated versions.
en.success_key: Start from approved sources, divide responsibilities clearly and keep human review, so each piece carries only a few actionable points. Building official resources, version maintenance and anonymous employee feedback into the process is what keeps improving quality and trust.

zh.title: 鄰氯苯酚樣品送驗鋁箔防逸散包裝指引
zh.summary: 針對鄰氯苯酚（o-Chlorophenol）樣品送交廠商檢測時可能產生的氣味逸散、滲漏及運送碰撞風險，建立標準化送驗包裝方式。以具 PTFE 墊片的螺旋蓋玻璃樣品瓶為第一層密封，搭配密封袋、鋁箔完整包覆、外層密封袋及硬質防撞外盒，降低氣味逸散與樣品外洩風險。本版本不使用吸附材料，並搭配圖卡方式協助現場人員快速理解與正確執行。
zh.author: 林玟臻
zh.status: 完成包裝方式與宣導圖卡設計
zh.region: 各廠區
zh.problem_background: 鄰氯苯酚樣品送交外部廠商檢測時，因物質具有明顯氣味及危害性，若樣品瓶密封性不足或外部包裝不完整，可能在暫存及運送過程中產生氣味逸散、滲漏或容器碰撞破損等問題。現場需要一套簡單、清楚且容易執行的包裝方式，並希望在不使用吸附材料的前提下，加強氣味阻隔及運送防護。
zh.core_problem: 如何在不使用吸附材料的情況下，透過樣品瓶密封、密封袋、鋁箔包覆及硬質外盒等多層防護，降低鄰氯苯酚樣品於送驗過程中的氣味逸散與滲漏風險，同時讓現場人員可以快速理解並依一致方式執行。
zh.solution: 建立「樣品瓶 → 內層密封袋 → 鋁箔完整包覆 → 外層密封袋 → 硬質防撞外盒」的多層包裝方式。樣品優先使用具 PTFE 墊片的螺旋蓋玻璃樣品瓶，確認瓶蓋旋緊且瓶身外部無污染後，先置入耐化學性密封袋，再以鋁箔完整包覆並將接縫向內折疊，之後放入第二層密封袋，最後置入硬質外盒並使用適當緩衝材料固定。採樣與封裝應於通風良好處或具局部排氣的區域進行，並依 SDS 穿戴適當 PPE；送交物流或廠商前，再確認危險品運輸及收樣規定。
process: 確認送驗廠商對樣品容器、樣品量及運送方式的要求。
依 SDS 確認鄰氯苯酚危害資訊及所需個人防護具。
於通風良好處或具局部排氣的區域完成採樣與封裝。
使用具 PTFE 墊片的螺旋蓋玻璃樣品瓶盛裝樣品，確認瓶蓋旋緊且外部無污染。
將樣品瓶放入第一層耐化學性密封袋並確實封口。
將密封袋外層以鋁箔完整包覆，接縫向內折疊，增加氣味阻隔並減少光照。
將鋁箔包覆後的樣品再放入第二層密封袋並確實封口。
放入硬質防撞外盒，以適當緩衝材料固定，避免運送過程碰撞或擠壓。
完成樣品名稱、編號、採樣日期、採樣人員及必要危害資訊標示。
交寄前確認 SDS、危險品運輸規定及物流／檢測廠商收樣要求。

extensions: 可依不同化學品的 SDS、物化特性及相容性，調整容器材質與包裝方式後套用至其他化學品樣品送驗。

limitations: 本案例的鋁箔屬輔助阻隔層，不能取代樣品瓶本身的氣密與防漏功能。
若包裝完成後仍可明顯聞到氣味，應先檢查瓶蓋是否旋緊、墊片是否適用或更換密封性較佳的樣品瓶，不應僅增加鋁箔層數處理。
樣品容器材質及包裝材料須確認與樣品相容，不得使用可能與樣品發生反應的材料。
採樣及封裝應在通風良好處或具局部排氣的區域進行，並依 SDS 穿戴適當 PPE。
高濃度或純品送驗前，應依 SDS 及相關危險品運輸規定確認包裝、標示及運送方式。
交由物流、快遞或外部廠商運送前，應確認承運單位是否接受該類化學品及其包裝要求。
本版本依需求不使用吸附材料；實際包裝仍應以法規、SDS、分析方法、檢測廠商及承運單位要求為準。

en.title: Aluminum Foil Anti-Emission Packaging Guide for o-Chlorophenol Sample Submission
en.summary: To address odor emission, leakage and impact risks when o-chlorophenol samples are sent to external labs for testing, a standardized submission packaging method was established. A screw-cap glass sample bottle with a PTFE-lined cap forms the first seal, followed by a sealed bag, full aluminum foil wrapping, an outer sealed bag and a rigid impact-resistant box to reduce odor emission and leakage. This version uses no absorbent materials and comes with info cards that help on-site staff understand and carry out the steps correctly.
en.author: 林玟臻
en.status: Packaging method and awareness cards completed
en.problem_background: o-Chlorophenol has a strong odor and is hazardous. When samples are sent to external labs, an inadequately sealed bottle or incomplete outer packaging can lead to odor emission, leakage or breakage during storage and transport. The site needed a simple, clear and easy-to-follow packaging method that improves odor barrier and transport protection without using absorbent materials.
en.core_problem: How to reduce odor emission and leakage of o-chlorophenol samples during submission through multiple layers—sealed bottle, sealed bags, foil wrapping and a rigid box—without absorbent materials, while letting on-site staff understand and follow the same method quickly.
en.solution: Establish a multi-layer packaging sequence: sample bottle → inner sealed bag → full aluminum foil wrap → outer sealed bag → rigid impact-resistant box. Samples go in a screw-cap glass bottle with a PTFE liner; after confirming the cap is tight and the outside is clean, the bottle is placed in a chemical-resistant sealed bag, fully wrapped in foil with seams folded inward, placed in a second sealed bag, and finally secured in a rigid box with suitable cushioning. Sampling and packing take place in a well-ventilated area or under local exhaust, with PPE worn per the SDS; dangerous goods transport and lab acceptance rules are confirmed before shipping.
process: Confirm the testing lab's requirements for sample containers, quantity and shipping method.
Check o-chlorophenol hazard information and required PPE in the SDS.
Sample and pack in a well-ventilated area or under local exhaust.
Fill a screw-cap glass sample bottle with a PTFE liner; confirm the cap is tight and the outside is clean.
Place the bottle in the first chemical-resistant sealed bag and seal it.
Fully wrap the sealed bag in aluminum foil, folding seams inward to improve odor barrier and reduce light exposure.
Place the foil-wrapped sample in a second sealed bag and seal it.
Put it in a rigid impact-resistant box secured with suitable cushioning to prevent knocks or crushing.
Label the sample name, number, sampling date, sampler and required hazard information.
Before shipping, confirm the SDS, dangerous goods transport rules and courier/lab acceptance requirements.

features.desc: Bottle, sealed bags, foil and outer bag form multiple barriers.

features.desc: Reduces odor emission and limits light exposure to the sample.

value.name: For operating units
value.desc: A consistent, easy-to-follow way to pack chemical samples, reducing ad-hoc decisions and repeated communication.

extensions: Adjust container materials and packaging for other chemical samples based on each chemical's SDS, properties and compatibility.
Extend to checklists for chemical sampling, temporary storage, handover and pre-shipment checks.
Include the info cards in EHS training, chemical management materials or on-site work instructions.
Build a standard sample packaging library for different chemicals, shared across plants.
limitations: The foil here is a supplementary barrier and cannot replace the airtightness and leak-proofing of the sample bottle itself.
If odor is still noticeable after packing, first check whether the cap is tight and the liner is suitable, or switch to a better-sealing bottle—don't just add more foil.
Container and packaging materials must be compatible with the sample; never use materials that may react with it.
Sampling and packing should take place in a well-ventilated area or under local exhaust, with PPE worn per the SDS.
Before submitting concentrated or pure samples, confirm packaging, labeling and shipping per the SDS and dangerous goods transport rules.
Before handing over to a courier or external lab, confirm the carrier accepts this type of chemical and its packaging requirements.
This version uses no absorbent materials by request; actual packaging must still follow regulations, the SDS, the analytical method, the lab and the carrier.
en.success_key: Treat container sealing as the top priority for preventing odor emission, with foil only as an extra barrier. A fixed multi-layer packing order, clear labeling and visual awareness reduce operator differences, and SDS, lab acceptance and transport rules are confirmed before submission.

zh.title: SOP制度標準化：建立一致、可追溯的作業管理機制
zh.summary: 透過流程盤點、文件格式統一、權責明確化及版本管理，建立可執行、可查核、可持續改善的標準作業程序（SOP）制度。結合教育訓練與成效追蹤，降低作業差異及經驗傳承落差，提升跨部門協作效率與服務品質。
zh.unit_request: 各業務及作業單位（實際單位待確認）
zh.author: 林玟臻
zh.status: 導入規劃中（本表為提案草案，實際進度待確認）
zh.region: 組織內各營運據點；涉及地區法規或作業差異時，另訂適用版本。
zh.problem_background: 各單位長期依賴個人經驗與口頭傳承執行作業，既有文件的格式、內容深度及更新方式不一，容易造成同一項工作出現不同做法。當人員異動、業務擴張或跨部門交接時，可能增加溝通、訓練及重工成本，因此需要建立統一的SOP管理制度。
zh.core_problem: 同一流程缺乏一致的執行標準，權責與交接條件不夠明確；文件分散且版本難以辨識，異常處理依賴個人判斷；缺乏定期檢討及成效追蹤機制，使文件與實際作業容易脫節。以上為本提案預設改善情境，須於流程盤點時確認。
zh.solution: 建立SOP全生命週期管理制度，涵蓋編寫、審查、核准、發布、訓練、執行、查核與修訂。統一文件範本及編碼規則，明確記錄適用範圍、流程權責、操作步驟、必要表單、檢核標準與異常處理方式，並以集中式文件平台管理有效版本。先選擇高頻或高風險流程試行，確認可行後逐步推廣。
process: 現況盤點｜訪談實際作業人員，整理既有文件與流程差異，確認問題及改善優先順序。
制度設計｜訂定SOP範本、文件編碼、權責分工、核准層級及版本管理規則。
文件編寫｜由流程負責人依實際作業撰寫步驟、輸入輸出、檢核點、交接條件及異常處理。
審查驗證｜邀請相關單位審查，透過實際情境演練確認內容完整且可執行。
核准發布｜完成核准後公告生效日期，集中發布有效版本，舊版保留紀錄並禁止誤用。
教育訓練｜依職務安排說明、操作示範與理解確認，保存訓練紀錄。
試行追蹤｜蒐集使用者回饋，記錄處理時間、錯誤、重工及異常情況，修正不適用內容。
持續改善｜依風險與變更需求定期檢討；流程、系統或規範變更時啟動修訂及再訓練。

現場出現例外情況時，依核准的通報及處理機制執行，並留下紀錄供後續修訂。
成效指標須明確定義計算方式與資料來源，依實際紀錄驗證，不以預期成果代替已達成成果。
zh.success_key: 由管理階層支持制度推動，讓實際作業人員參與編寫及驗證，並為每項流程指定明確負責人。以容易理解、現場可用的文件與檢核工具落實執行，將訓練、查核及回饋修訂納入日常管理，持續維持文件與實務的一致性。

en.title: SOP Standardization: Building a Consistent, Traceable Work Management System
en.summary: Through process inventory, unified document formats, clear responsibilities and version control, this case builds a standard operating procedure (SOP) system that is executable, auditable and continuously improved. Combined with training and results tracking, it reduces variation between workers and gaps in knowledge transfer, improving cross-department collaboration and service quality.
en.unit_request: Business and operating units (exact units to be confirmed)
en.author: 林玟臻
en.status: Rollout in planning (this form is a draft proposal; actual progress to be confirmed)
en.region: All operating sites; separate versions are issued where local regulations or practices differ.
en.problem_background: Units have long relied on personal experience and word of mouth to carry out their work, and existing documents vary in format, depth and how they are updated—so the same task is often done in different ways. Staff changes, business growth and cross-department handovers can increase communication, training and rework costs, so a unified SOP management system is needed.
en.core_problem: The same process lacks a consistent standard, and responsibilities and handover conditions are unclear; documents are scattered and versions hard to identify, exceptions depend on individual judgment, and there is no regular review or results tracking, so documents drift away from actual practice. These are the assumed improvement scenarios for this proposal and must be confirmed during the process inventory.
en.solution: Establish full-lifecycle SOP management covering writing, review, approval, release, training, execution, audit and revision. Unify the document template and numbering rules; clearly record scope, process responsibilities, steps, required forms, check criteria and exception handling; and manage current versions on a central document platform. Pilot with high-frequency or high-risk processes first, then roll out gradually once proven.
process: Current-state inventory | Interview the people who do the work, compile existing documents and process differences, and confirm problems and priorities.
System design | Define the SOP template, document numbering, responsibilities, approval levels and version control rules.
Writing | Process owners write steps, inputs and outputs, checkpoints, handover conditions and exception handling based on actual work.
Review and validation | Invite related units to review, and confirm through real scenario walk-throughs that content is complete and workable.
Approval and release | After approval, announce the effective date and publish the current version centrally; old versions are kept on record and blocked from use.
Training | Provide explanations, demonstrations and comprehension checks by role, and keep training records.
Pilot tracking | Collect user feedback, record handling time, errors, rework and exceptions, and correct content that doesn't fit.
Continuous improvement | Review regularly based on risk and change needs; trigger revision and retraining when processes, systems or rules change.

features.name: Unified document template
features.desc: Always presents purpose, scope, responsibilities, steps, forms and check criteria, reducing misunderstandings.

features.name: Process and responsibility mapping
features.desc: Clearly marks who executes, reviews, approves and hands over, avoiding gaps.

features.name: Document version control
features.desc: Records revision, effective date, reason for change and approval, ensuring the current document is used.

features.name: Central search and permissions
features.desc: Find documents by process or keyword, with read and edit rights set by role.

features.name: Exception handling and feedback
features.desc: Defines how exceptions are reported and escalated, feeding site issues into improvement tracking.

features.name: Training and audit records
features.desc: Keeps learning, execution and spot-check results as the basis for improvement and audits.

ai_usage: Draft preparation | Helps turn authorized interview notes and existing documents into SOP drafts in the unified format.
Consistency checks | Helps find inconsistent terms, missing steps and vague responsibilities for process owners to confirm.
Training materials | Generates instructions, scenario questions and FAQs from approved SOPs, reviewed by designated staff.
Document lookup | Within permitted access, provides search summaries from current versions, citing the source document and revision.

tools.name: Document editor (e.g. Word)
tools.desc: Write and review SOPs using the unified template.

tools.name: Flowchart tool (e.g. Visio)
tools.desc: Show task order, decision points and cross-department handovers.

tools.name: Approved document management platform
tools.desc: Store documents centrally and manage permissions, versions and approvals.

tools.name: Spreadsheet or reporting tool
tools.desc: Track document progress, training records and process KPIs.

tools.name: Approved AI tools
tools.desc: Assist with drafts, content checks and training materials; confirm data protection requirements before use.

results: Expected | An SOP management policy, unified document template and process document register.
Expected | SOPs, responsibility matrices, checklists and exception reporting rules for the pilot processes.
Expected | Record-keeping for current-version release, document revisions and staff training.
Validation | Set a baseline before rollout, then compare handling time, error rate, rework rate and new-hire training time afterward; targets and actual results to be confirmed.

value.name: For business units
value.desc: Fewer differences in how work is understood, clearer handovers and more efficient cross-department collaboration.

value.name: For customers
value.desc: Consistent work and service standards improve response quality and service stability.

value.name: For the company
value.desc: Process knowledge that can be passed on, less dependence on individuals, and better management transparency and audit traceability.

extensions: Apply to procurement, payment requests, customer service, order handling, onboarding/offboarding and equipment maintenance.
Extend to cross-site process integration, keeping common standards with local work appendices where needed.
Later combine with e-forms and approval systems to turn key checkpoints into system controls.
Build role-based training materials and a knowledge base to support onboarding and job coverage.
limitations: SOP content must be validated in actual work and approved by the responsible unit, so documents don't exist only on paper.
High-risk or regulated processes must be reviewed by the appropriate specialists and updated per applicable rules.
AI output is only a draft aid and cannot be used directly as the official basis for work; never enter confidential or personal data into unapproved tools.
The document platform must manage access, archive old versions and keep backups to prevent use of obsolete documents.
When exceptions occur on site, follow the approved reporting and handling process and keep records for later revision.
KPIs must have clearly defined formulas and data sources and be verified against actual records—expected results are not achieved results.
en.success_key: Management backs the rollout, the people who do the work help write and validate it, and every process has a clear owner. Easy-to-understand, usable documents and checklists put it into practice, and training, audits and feedback-driven revisions become part of daily management to keep documents in line with reality.

zh.title: 一般性作業安全許可證－臨時使用與職安確認增修
zh.summary: 針對一般性作業安全許可證，於「施工內容」下方增設臨時使用申請、缺繳資料項目與職安補繳確認欄位，使突發作業、人員資料未齊及後續追蹤處理均能在同一張表單中完整留存。
zh.author: 林玟臻
zh.region: 無菌二廠
zh.problem_background: 一般性作業可能因生產突發狀況、主管臨時交辦、施工人員臨時更換或入廠資料尚未繳齊而需立即進場。原有許可證缺少臨時使用原因、資料缺繳類別及職安後續追蹤的集中記錄欄位。
zh.core_problem: 臨時使用的核准依據與補件進度未能於同一份許可證中清楚呈現，增加資料追蹤、罰款轉回及矯正預防處理的管理難度。
zh.solution: 於「施工內容」下方新增「□ 臨時使用」及「職安確認欄」兩個區塊；以勾選式欄位標準化申請原因、缺繳資料與後續處理方式，並加入一週內補件確認規範。
process: 施工單位填寫一般性作業安全許可證與施工內容。
如屬臨時使用，勾選使用原因並填寫其他因素說明。
勾選缺繳資料項目：勞保、教育訓練及／或團保。
職安於一週內確認資料上傳時間與補繳結果。
未符合者依規定開立扣款單、矯正及預防處理單或註明其他處理方式。

features.name: 臨時使用勾選
features.desc: 標示本案是否屬臨時使用。

features.name: 使用原因說明
features.desc: 提供 8 項原因，包含生產突發、主管臨時交辦、未事前申請及其他因素。

features.name: 缺繳資料複選
features.desc: 可同時勾選勞保、教育訓練及團保。

features.name: 資料補繳追蹤
features.desc: 記錄資料上傳時間及符合／不符合結果。

features.name: 後續處理紀錄
features.desc: 填寫扣款單、矯正及預防處理單或其他處理方式。

ai_usage: 依既有許可證版面與指定文字，協助整理新增欄位、資訊層級及可列印的表單版面。
將使用規則轉換為一致的勾選欄與追蹤欄位，降低手動設計與遺漏風險。

tools.name: HTML／CSS
tools.desc: 建立可於瀏覽器開啟與列印的表單增修版。

tools.name: Markdown
tools.desc: 整理本案例的可匯入案例資料。

results: 完成一般性作業安全許可證臨時使用增修版。
新增臨時使用原因與缺繳資料項目之標準化勾選欄位。
新增職安一週內確認、扣款與矯正預防處理追蹤欄位。

value.name: 對業務單位
value.desc: 可於緊急或臨時作業情境下保留清楚的申請與核准依據。

value.name: 對客戶
value.desc: 施工人員與承攬商可明確了解補繳要求及期限。

value.name: 對公司
value.desc: 集中管理補繳狀態與後續處置，提升職安稽核可追溯性。

extensions: 可套用至其他類型作業許可證的臨時使用與補件追蹤流程。
可延伸串接表單系統，將勾選結果轉為逾期提醒、扣款或缺失單流程。
limitations: 臨時使用原因與缺繳項目應由申請單位據實勾選。
職安確認應於一週內完成；廠商未繳回時依規定轉回罰款。
無法扣款的廠商應開立矯正及預防處理單。
zh.success_key: 將申請原因、缺繳資料、補繳時程與後續處置整合於同一份表單，並以明確勾選項目降低填寫歧義。

en.title: General Work Safety Permit – Adding Temporary Use and Safety Confirmation Sections
en.summary: Below the "Work Content" field of the general work safety permit, new sections were added for temporary-use requests, missing documents and safety follow-up confirmation, so urgent jobs, incomplete worker records and later follow-up can all be fully recorded on the same form.
en.author: 林玟臻
en.problem_background: General work may need to start immediately because of production emergencies, last-minute requests from supervisors, sudden changes of workers, or site-entry documents not yet submitted. The original permit had no place to record the reason for temporary use, the type of missing documents, or the safety unit's follow-up.
en.core_problem: The basis for approving temporary use and the progress of document submission were not clearly shown on the same permit, making it harder to track documents, apply penalty deductions and handle corrective and preventive actions.
en.solution: Add two sections below "Work Content": "□ Temporary Use" and "Safety Confirmation." Checkbox fields standardize the request reason, missing documents and follow-up actions, and a rule requiring document confirmation within one week was added.
process: The contractor/work unit fills in the general work safety permit and work content.
For temporary use, tick the reason and describe any other factors.
Tick the missing documents: labor insurance, safety training and/or group insurance.
The safety unit confirms the upload time and submission result within one week.
If not compliant, issue a deduction slip or corrective and preventive action form, or note another handling method, per the rules.

features.name: Temporary use checkbox
features.desc: Marks whether the job is a temporary-use case.

features.name: Reason for use
features.desc: Eight options, including production emergency, supervisor's last-minute request, no advance application and other factors.

features.name: Missing documents (multi-select)
features.desc: Labor insurance, training and group insurance can be ticked together.

features.name: Document follow-up
features.desc: Records the upload time and compliant/non-compliant result.

features.name: Follow-up action record
features.desc: Records deduction slips, corrective and preventive action forms or other handling.

ai_usage: Based on the existing permit layout and specified wording, helped organize the new fields, information hierarchy and a printable form layout.
Turned the usage rules into consistent checkbox and tracking fields, reducing manual design effort and the risk of omissions.

tools.name: HTML/CSS
tools.desc: Built the revised form so it can be opened and printed in a browser.

tools.name: Markdown
tools.desc: Organized this case into importable case data.

results: Completed the temporary-use revision of the general work safety permit.
Added standardized checkboxes for temporary-use reasons and missing documents.
Added fields for one-week safety confirmation, deductions and corrective/preventive action tracking.

value.name: For operating units
value.desc: A clear record of the request and approval basis for urgent or temporary jobs.

value.name: For contractors
value.desc: Workers and contractors clearly understand what must be submitted and by when.

value.name: For the company
value.desc: Central tracking of submission status and follow-up, improving traceability for safety audits.

extensions: Apply the same temporary-use and document follow-up flow to other types of work permits.
Connect to a form system so ticked items trigger overdue reminders, deductions or non-conformance workflows.
limitations: Temporary-use reasons and missing documents must be ticked truthfully by the applying unit.
Safety confirmation should be completed within one week; if the contractor does not submit, the penalty is deducted per the rules.
For contractors where deduction isn't possible, a corrective and preventive action form should be issued.
en.success_key: Bring the request reason, missing documents, submission deadline and follow-up action together on one form, with clear checkbox options to reduce ambiguity when filling it in.

zh.title: 異常工作負荷管理辦法修訂
zh.summary: 以 AI 逐條對照現行法規與官方指引，檢視公司的《異常工作負荷危害預防管理辦法》（A-SEA-020），在保留公司既有架構與流程的前提下完成修訂版，所有修改處都清楚標示。
zh.author: 陳佳勳
zh.status: 已完成修訂版（2026 年 8–9 月）
zh.region: 台灣
zh.problem_background: 公司訂有《異常工作負荷危害預防管理辦法》（文件編號 A-SEA-020），作為推動異常工作負荷促發疾病預防的依據。管理辦法需要與現行職業安全衛生法規及官方指引保持一致，並符合公司實際的作業流程。
zh.core_problem: 要確認辦法是否符合現行規定，必須把辦法條文與法規、指引逐條比對，內容多、比對費時，人工閱讀也容易遺漏；修訂後還要讓審核的人看得出改了哪裡、為什麼改。
zh.solution: 由職護提供現行辦法、相關法規與官方指引，請 AI 逐條對照，找出需要補充或調整的地方，在保留公司既有架構與流程的前提下提出修訂文字，產出修改處清楚標示的追蹤修訂版，由職護逐項確認。

en.title: Revising the Abnormal Workload Management Procedure
en.summary: AI was used to compare the company's Abnormal Workload Hazard Prevention Procedure (A-SEA-020) clause by clause against current regulations and official guidelines, producing a revised version that keeps the company's existing structure and workflow, with every change clearly marked.
en.author: 陳佳勳
en.problem_background: The company maintains an Abnormal Workload Hazard Prevention Procedure (document no. A-SEA-020) as the basis for preventing diseases triggered by abnormal workload. The procedure must stay consistent with current occupational safety and health regulations and official guidelines, and match the company's actual workflow.
en.core_problem: Checking whether the procedure complies with current rules means comparing each clause against regulations and guidelines—a large, time-consuming job where manual reading easily misses things. After revising, reviewers also need to see what changed and why.
en.solution: The occupational health nurse provides the current procedure, related regulations and official guidelines, and AI compares them clause by clause, identifies what needs to be added or adjusted, and proposes revised wording that keeps the company's existing structure and workflow. The result is a tracked-changes version with every change clearly marked, which the nurse confirms item by item.
process: The nurse provides the current procedure (A-SEA-020), related regulations and the Guidelines for Preventing Diseases Triggered by Abnormal Workload
AI compares the procedure with the regulations and guidelines clause by clause
AI lists the clauses that need revision and the reasons
Draft revised wording while keeping the company's existing structure and workflow
Produce a tracked-changes version with all changes clearly marked
The nurse confirms each revision item by item

features.desc: Compares each clause with current regulations and official guidelines

features.name: Revision suggestions
features.desc: Points out clauses to add or adjust, with the basis for each

features.name: Tracked-changes version
features.desc: Changes are clearly marked so reviewers see at a glance what changed

features.desc: Only the content that needs changing is adjusted; the company's chapters and workflow stay as they are

ai_usage: Reading the original text of regulations and official guidelines
Comparing the company procedure with regulations and guidelines clause by clause
Drafting revised wording in the company's existing terminology and format
Marking changes and explaining the reason for each

tools.desc: Reads regulations and guidelines, compares clauses and drafts revised wording

tools.name: Word
tools.desc: Manages the tracked-changes version of the procedure

results: Completed the revised Abnormal Workload Hazard Prevention Procedure (A-SEA-020)

Example revisions: physician interviews are now arranged based on the combined assessment of cardiovascular disease risk and workload risk; a new requirement that before the interview, workers are told their health and privacy data will be handled under the Personal Data Protection Act and not disclosed
Changes are clearly marked and ready for review

value.name: For employees

value.name: For the company

extensions: The same clause-by-clause approach can be used for procedures and work instructions of other health protection programs
When regulations or guidelines are updated, the same approach can quickly check which clauses are affected
limitations: The revised version takes effect only after the nurse confirms it and it passes the company's document control review

zh.title: 近三年員工心理健康趨勢分析
zh.summary: 以 AI 整合 2024–2026 年三年、四廠共 12 份量表資料，首次完成跨年度的員工心理健康趨勢報告，以圖表呈現各項目的變化；並依 2026 年度量表結果（有效樣本 682 人）完成分析報告，提出 EAP（員工協助方案）導入建議。
zh.author: 陳佳勳
zh.region: 台灣（四廠：無菌一廠、無菌二廠、無菌三廠、自貿廠）
zh.problem_background: 公司每年都會在員工健康檢查時請員工填寫心理健康相關量表（壓力指數測量、簡式健康量表 BSRS-5），各廠各年度的結果分別存成不同檔案。每年的資料都只在當年度使用，沒有放在一起比較。
zh.core_problem: 三年、四廠共 12 份資料，以人工整合並比較的工作量大，因此過去一直沒有做過跨年度的分析，無法知道員工的心理健康狀況是變好還是變差、哪些項目需要優先關注。
zh.solution: 由職護提供三年、四廠的量表資料，請 AI 整合成同一套格式，統計各年度、各項目的結果，製作趨勢圖表並整理成報告，由職護確認內容與解讀。
process: 職護準備 2024–2026 年四廠共 12 份量表資料
AI 檢查各份資料的欄位與格式，整合成一致的結構
AI 統計各年度、各項目的結果
AI 製作趨勢圖表並整理成報告

en.title: Three-Year Employee Mental Health Trend Analysis
en.summary: AI was used to combine 12 questionnaire datasets from four plants over three years (2024–2026), producing the company's first cross-year employee mental health trend report with charts showing how each item changed. An analysis report based on the 2026 questionnaire results (682 valid responses) was also completed, with recommendations for introducing an EAP (Employee Assistance Program).
en.author: 陳佳勳
en.region: Taiwan (four plants: Aseptic Plants 1, 2 and 3, and the Free Trade Zone Plant)
en.problem_background: Each year during health checkups, employees fill in mental health questionnaires (a stress index and the Brief Symptom Rating Scale, BSRS-5). Results for each plant and year were saved in separate files and only used for that year, never compared side by side.
en.core_problem: Manually combining and comparing 12 datasets across three years and four plants is a big job, so no cross-year analysis had ever been done. There was no way to tell whether employee mental health was improving or worsening, or which items needed priority attention.
en.solution: The occupational health nurse provided three years of questionnaire data from four plants. AI merged them into one consistent format, calculated results by year and item, built trend charts and compiled a report, and the nurse confirmed the content and interpretation.
process: The nurse prepares 12 questionnaire datasets from four plants for 2024–2026
AI checks each dataset's fields and format and merges them into a consistent structure
AI calculates results by year and by item
AI builds trend charts and compiles the report
Summarize key findings from the current year's results and propose EAP recommendations
The nurse confirms the statistics and interpretation

zh.title: 呼吸防護計畫生理評估
zh.summary: 以 AI 協助檢視呼吸防護計畫，把是否需要轉介醫師的判斷整理成三個步驟，並將 28 位呼吸防護具配戴人員的生理評估結果彙整成一張表，另整理一份逐案判定原因說明，作為職護留存紀錄及與職安、臨場服務醫師溝通的依據。
zh.author: 陳佳勳
zh.region: 台灣
zh.problem_background: 依呼吸防護計畫，需要配戴呼吸防護具的人員在使用前要先做生理評估，確認身體狀況適合配戴，必要時轉介醫師進一步評估。是否需要轉介，要同時看問卷的勾選項目、個人病史，以及任務與防護具的負荷程度。
zh.core_problem: 轉介的判斷條件分散在法規附表、技術手冊與公司辦法中，哪些是法規強制、哪些是公司可以裁量，並不容易一眼分清楚。逐一對照每位人員的評估表費時，也不容易確保每個人都用同樣的標準判斷；評估完成後缺少一份一目了然的總表，判定的理由也沒有留下紀錄。
zh.solution: 請 AI 檢視呼吸防護計畫內容，把轉介判斷整理成依序檢查的三個步驟，並標明每一步是法規強制還是公司裁量。再依這三個步驟整理 28 位配戴人員的評估結果，彙整成一張表，同時逐案寫下判定原因，由職護確認後使用。
process: 職護提供呼吸防護計畫與配戴人員的生理評估資料
AI 檢視計畫內容，整理出轉介判斷的條件，並區分法規強制與公司裁量
將判斷條件簡化為三個步驟，由職護確認
依三步驟整理 28 位配戴人員的評估結果，彙整成一張總表
整理逐案判定原因說明，標出職護提出的延伸判斷
職護複核後使用，並據以與職安、臨場服務醫師討論
